# ============================================================================
# ****************    CLASSES    *********************************************
# ============================================================================

urpx:AccountServiceAgreement a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Account Service Agreement"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links rate plan contracts to service delivery terms" ;
    skos:note "Provides the contractual framework for rate plan application to allow for eligibility definitions. Service account and agreement data lives in customer data, not URPX." .

urpx:AdministrativeBoundary a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Administrative Boundary"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Government-defined geographic boundary for administrative purposes" ;
    skos:note "Standard administrative divisions used for regulatory and statistical purposes." .

urpx:AlternativeDimension a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Alternative Dimension"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Dimension along which price set alternatives differ using ontology properties" ;
    skos:note "Defines the customer profile attribute that determines which PriceSetAlternative applies. Uses actual ontology properties from Customer Profile or Service Point Profile (e.g., urpx:hasCustomerKind, urpx:voltageLevel). When no suitable URPX property exists, customDimensionProperty may provide a fallback identifier." .

urpx:AlternativeDimensions a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Alternative Dimensions"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Dimensions defining the set of profileAlternatives. " ;
    skos:note "Wrapper for multiple alternative dimensions within a ProfileAlternatives context. Organizes related dimensions and their metadata, enabling complex alternative structures with multiple dimensions of variation." .

urpx:ApplicabilityGroup a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Applicability Group"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Geographic and service class applicability rules for statement prices" ;
    skos:note "Defines where and to whom statement prices apply. Supports complex applicability rules common in regulatory filings." .

urpx:ApplicabilityRule a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Applicability Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Conditions determining when a price applies to usage" ;
    skos:note "Determines price application. Different from eligibility - this is for when a price applies during billing, not who can use the rate plan." .

urpx:BillingCycle a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Billing Cycle"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Standardized billing period definitions" ;
    skos:note "Provides standardized cycle definitions for rate plan application and temporal alignment across systems." .

urpx:BillingModel a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Billing Model"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Billing-specific rules and calculation patterns for rate plan version with ledger-based organization" ;
    skos:note """Defines billing calculation rules, proration patterns, and adjustment mechanisms. Contains one or more ledgers for organizing prices by billing category (supply, delivery, etc.). Each ledger can have multiple MetricInputs for per-meter or per-service-point pricing.""" .

urpx:BooleanOperationNode a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Boolean Operation Node"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Boolean combinator node in a condition expression tree"@en ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:ConditionNode ;
    skos:note "Used for AND OR NOT composition inside a ConditionExpression tree. Uses operandNodes only and never leftOperand or rightOperand." .

urpx:CalculationMethod a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Calculation Method"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Defines how prices are calculated over billing intervals" ;
    skos:note "Specifies the method for calculating prices associated with a ledger based on billing intervals. Supports complex billing scenarios by allowing combinations of calculation methods." .

urpx:ComparisonNode a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Comparison Node"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Atomic comparison predicate in a condition expression"@en ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:ConditionNode ;
    skos:note "Reusable atomic predicate. Uses operator, leftOperand, and rightOperand." .

urpx:ConditionExpression a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Condition Expression"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Rule-level wrapper for structured condition applicability used in EligibilityRule, ApplicabilityRule, ApplicabilityGroup, ProfileAlternative"@en ;
    skos:note "Carries exactly one rootNode. The root is a ConditionNode, either a ComparisonNode or a BooleanOperationNode." .

urpx:ConditionNode a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Condition Node"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Abstract superclass for nodes that may appear in a ConditionExpression tree"@en ;
    skos:note "Structural superclass for ComparisonNode and BooleanOperationNode." .

urpx:County a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "County"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "County or equivalent second-level administrative division" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:AdministrativeBoundary ;
    skos:note """Second-level administrative division for local governance.
                 Important for municipal utilities and local regulatory oversight.
                 
                 Standards Alignment:
                 - FIPS county codes for standardized identification
                 - Census county definitions for demographic data
                 - Geographic business practices for utility operations""" .

urpx:CustomOperandNode a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Custom Operand Node"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Fallback operand node for custom condition properties and custom literal values"@en ;
    skos:note "Use only when no suitable URPX-native property exists. Literal-bearing nodes may also optionally carry referencesMetricInput." .

urpx:CustomerProfile a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Customer Profile"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Customer business and social characteristics for rate eligibility and program participation evaluation" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:Profile ;
    skos:note "Represents customer business, social, and program participation characteristics. Includes assistance program support." .

urpx:DataSourceReference a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Data Source Reference"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Structured reference to a data source including filename, URL, and media type." ;
    skos:note "Used to provide traceability for data points back to their original source files or APIs." .

urpx:DatatypeOperandNode a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Datatype Operand Node"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Operand node for datatype-valued condition properties and datatype literal values"@en ;
    skos:note "Use conditionProperty for a datatype-valued property reference or one datatype-specific value property for a literal. Literal-bearing nodes may also optionally carry referencesMetricInput." .

urpx:DERExportsDocument a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "DER Exports Document"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "DER export pricing structures for distributed energy resources" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:URPXDocument ;
    skos:note "Container for distributed energy resource export pricing. Standards Alignment (Future): IEEE 1547 (Interconnection standards), DERMS (DER Management Systems integration), CSIP (Common Smart Inverter Profile)." .

urpx:DistributedEnergyResource a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Distributed Energy Resource"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "On-site generation and storage capabilities" ;
    skos:note "Represents distributed energy resources (DER) including solar, storage, EV charging, and wind. Enables rate plan selection for customers with generation and storage capabilities." .

urpx:DynamicPricing a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Dynamic Pricing"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Configuration for real-time or event-based variable pricing" ;
    skos:note "Enables market-based or event-driven pricing. Supports various update frequencies and price sources including wholesale markets." .

urpx:EligibilityRule a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Eligibility Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Conditions determining customer and service point qualification" ;
    skos:note "Defines who is eligible for sign up. Can reference measurement limits or types of customers and express complex boolean conditions. Provides criteria for matching customers and service delivery points and with rate plans and rate plan modifiers." .

urpx:GeneralRule a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "General Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "A rule or statement that applies across rate plans and rate plan versions, not tied to a single billing context" ;
    skos:note "Used for tariff book-level rules that are defined once and referenced by multiple RatePlanVersion and RatePlanModifierVersion instances." .

urpx:HighlyDynamicPricesDocument a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Highly Dynamic Prices Document"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Real-time pricing data requiring smart home and EMS integration" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:URPXDocument ;
    skos:note "Container for real-time dynamic pricing structures including full rate plans. Requires deep integration with smart home and utility/industrial EMS systems." .

urpx:Holiday a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Holiday"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Single holiday definition with date or calculation rule" ;
    skos:note "Individual holiday specification. Must have either specific date or rule. Supports observance rules for weekends. Defines scheduled temporal events affecting price application." .

urpx:HolidayCalendar a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Holiday Calendar"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Collection of holidays affecting TOU period application with versioning support" ;
    skos:note "Defines holidays for rate calculations. Aligned with utility industry CalendarTimeInterval patterns. Part of versioned LocationDataSet enabling holiday date changes year to year. Can be referenced independently by rate plans or through LocationDataSet." .

urpx:Ledger a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Ledger"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Enables multiple ledgers for separation of supply vs delivery charges or other billing segregations" ;
    skos:note "Utilities often separate supply and delivery charges into different ledgers. Supports complex billing scenarios with multiple charge categories. Each ledger can have its own set of prices and MetricInputs. Ledgers reference MetricInputs (many-to-many) rather than containing them." .

urpx:LocationDataSet a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Location Data Set"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Versioned auxiliary location data including holiday calendars, timezone, and DST rules" ;
    skos:note "Container for versioned location-specific auxiliary data needed for rate plan calculations. Bundles holiday calendars with timezone information and DST rules for temporal validity. Organizations publish versions as holidays change or timezone rules are updated." .

urpx:MetricInput a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "MetricInput"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Organizational unit for pricing rules supporting measured MetricInputs (raw meter data), profile MetricInputs (profile properties), and calculated MetricInputs (derived metrics)" ;
    skos:note "Defines a time based metric input to the cost model. Supports measured MetricInputs (meter data), profile MetricInputs (customer or service point profile properties), static or dynamic metrics derived from other inputs, and calculated metrics based on inputs from one or more MetricInput inputs (derived metrics like net export = generation - grid import)." .

urpx:MetricSpecification a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Metric Specification"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Measurement specification for common billing scenarios" ;
    skos:note "Defines what is being measured in a price. Covers: commodity, measurement kind, unit of measure, flow direction, accumulation" .

urpx:Municipality a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Municipality"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "City, town, or incorporated municipal area" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:AdministrativeBoundary ;
    skos:note "Incorporated municipal areas with local government authority." .

urpx:ObjectOperandNode a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Object Operand Node"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Operand node for object-valued condition properties and object references"@en ;
    skos:note "Use conditionProperty, referencesValue, or referencesMetricInput." .

urpx:OperationNode a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Operation Node"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Expression node for nested arithmetic or derived comparison preparation"@en ;
    skos:note "Used inside ComparisonNode expressions. Uses leftOperand and rightOperand and is distinct from BooleanOperationNode." .

urpx:Organization a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Organization"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Any entity participating in energy markets or rate regulation" ;
    skos:note """Base class for all organizational entities in the energy sector.
                 Includes utilities, regulators, ISOs/RTOs, aggregators, energy service companies, and parent holdings.
                 Supports international entities with flexible identification.""" .

urpx:OrganizationEvent a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Organization Event"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Corporate transition event affecting organization structure or identity" ;
    skos:note """Base class for M&A, rebranding, territory changes affecting organizations.
                 Tracks predecessor and successor relationships for rate plan continuity.""" .

urpx:OrganizationIdentifier a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Organization Identifier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "External identifier from regulatory or financial systems" ;
    skos:note """Captures EIA ID, DUNS, LEI, and other jurisdiction-specific identifiers.
                 Supports international identification schemes with issuing authority tracking.""" .
   
urpx:OrganizationIdentity a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Organization Identity"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Temporal identity record tracking names and identifiers over time" ;
    skos:note """Captures organization identity at a point in time with validity period.
                 Supports name changes, rebranding, and identifier updates.""" .              

urpx:OrganizationName a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Organization Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Name variant with type, language, and canonical/preferred status" ;
    skos:note """Supports multiple names per organization with different purposes.
                 Tracks canonical (official) and preferred (for display) designations.""" .

urpx:OrganizationTransition a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Organization Transition"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "N-ary relator for complex organization transitions" ;
    skos:note """Captures full context of organization changes including multiple
                 predecessors/successors, partial transfers, and regulatory approvals.""" .

urpx:PlanElements a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Plan Elements"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Centralized container for temporal and pricing elements of rate plan or modifier versions" ;
    skos:note "Contains parameters needed to set up cost model calculations including seasons, holiday calendars, metric input definitions, and billing model definitions. Used by both RatePlanVersion and RatePlanModifierVersion for unified structure." .

urpx:Price a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Price"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Individual pricing component with rate and applicability rules" ;
    skos:note "Represents a single billable component. Aligned with utility industry Price class concepts. Must have at least one pricing field. Can have start/end dates and expected end date." .

urpx:PriceDefinition a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Price Definition"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "A structural definition of a price, excluding instance-specific details like start/end dates, amount, and unit price." ;
    skos:note "PriceDefinition is used at the ledger level to define the metadata and calculation structure of a price, which is then instantiated in a RatePlanVersion or RatePlanModifier with specific values." .

urpx:PriceSet a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Price Set"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Logical grouping of related prices for organization and calculation" ;
    skos:note "Groups prices by purpose or calculation order. Aligned with utility industry PriceGroup concepts. Useful for separating fixed vs variable prices or organizing by service type. Can have start/end dates for temporal validity." .

urpx:Prices a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Prices"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Centralized container for all price-related content within a rate plan version. Consolidates base price sets and alternative price sets, providing single point of access for all prices. Each RatePlanVersion has exactly one Prices container." ;
    skos:note "Architectural container class. Separates price storage organization from rate plan structure. Contains hasPriceSet for default prices and hasPriceSetAlternatives for alternative configurations." .

urpx:PriceSetAlternative a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Price Set Alternative"@en ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:PriceSet ;
    rdfs:comment "Price set that represents one alternative in a mutually exclusive set of options. Subclass of PriceSet with required reference to applicable ProfileAlternative. Lives in Prices container alongside base price sets, but distinguished by its connection to dimension-based alternatives." ;
    skos:note "Required property: forProfileAlternative. This IRI reference links the price set to its defining ProfileAlternative in the ProfileAlternatives layer, enabling clean separation between dimension definition and price storage." .

urpx:PriceSetAlternatives a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Price Set Alternatives"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Set of price sets that represents a set of alternatives in a mutually exclusive set of options." ;
    skos:note "Set of Prices with mutually exclusive user choice. Includes two or more PriceSetAlternative instances. Linked to ProfileAlternatives with IRI reference." .

urpx:PriceSummary a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Price Summary"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Total or subtotal aggregating multiple price line items" ;
    skos:note """Aggregates multiple prices into totals/subtotals for billing presentation.
                 Explicitly references included line items to avoid double counting.
                 Supports transition from summary to detailed billing formats.""" .

urpx:PriceUpdateRule a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Price Update Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Rule defining when and how dynamic prices are calculated" ;
    skos:note "Governs dynamic price updates. Contains formulas and trigger conditions. Can reference external indices or internal calculations." .

urpx:PriorRatePlan a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Prior Rate Plan"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Reference to customer's previous rate plan for eligibility determination" ;
    skos:note "Tracks customer's rate plan history for eligibility rules that depend on previous enrollment. Separate from ProgramEnrollment to handle different eligibility patterns in utility rate structures." .

urpx:Profile a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Profile"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Abstract parent for all profile types used in rate plan eligibility and service delivery evaluation" ;
    skos:note "Subclasses define specific profile characteristics: CustomerProfile for business and social characteristics, ServicePointProfile for physical service delivery characteristics. No properties defined at this level - all properties live on concrete subclasses." .

urpx:ProfileAlternative a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Profile Alternative"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Specific combination of dimension values representing one alternative choice. Defines the dimensions along which price set alternatives differ, enabling mutually exclusive options for user selection. Each dimension set specifies dimension-value pairs that characterize a particular alternative configuration." ;
    skos:note "Dimension definition layer independent of price sets. Used to define alternatives based on customer profile characteristics, geographic locations, or service configurations." .

urpx:ProfileAlternatives a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Profile Alternatives"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Container for alternative dimension structures requiring user selection. Provides the bridge between customer profile characteristics and mutually exclusive alternative choices. Each ProfileAlternatives instance groups related alternative dimension sets that define the available options for a specific selection context." ;
    skos:note "Separates user selection layer from automatic filtering layer. Used when rate plan has mutually exclusive options requiring explicit user choice (e.g., selecting between different zone configurations or service levels)." .

urpx:ProgramEnrollment a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Program Enrollment"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Customer enrollment in utility programs for eligibility determination" ;
    skos:note "Tracks customer participation in utility programs (demand response, green energy, low-income assistance, etc.) for rate plan eligibility. Distinct from rate plan history to handle program-based eligibility patterns." .

urpx:RateCase a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Rate Case"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Public service commission proceeding concerning rate plan or price changes for cost-of-service regulated utilities" ;
    skos:note "Links to a formal rate case proceeding that may affect rate plan versions, rate plan modifier versions, price definitions, prices, price sets, or price set alternatives." .

urpx:RateGroup a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Rate Group"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Specific rate grouping within a service class (e.g., Rate I, Rate II)" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:ServiceClass ;
    skos:note """Subclass of ServiceClass that represents specific rate groups within a service class.
                 Enables organization of rates like "Service Class 2 Rate I" and "Service Class 2 Rate II"
                 while maintaining the service class hierarchy. Rate plans can reference either the
                 service class directly or via nested under specific rate groups.""" .

urpx:RatePlan a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Rate Plan"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Master template for a utility rate plan that contains temporal versions" ;
    owl:disjointWith urpx:RatePlanVersion ;
    skos:note "Represents the conceptual rate plan independent of time. Contains the stable identifier and houses all temporal versions of the rate." .

urpx:RatePlanModifier a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Rate Plan Modifier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Master template for a rate plan modifier that contains temporal versions" ;
    owl:disjointWith urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ;
    skos:note "Represents a conceptual modifier independent of time, parallel to RatePlan structure. Contains the stable identifier and houses all temporal versions of the modifier. Examples include low income discounts, green energy options, demand response, DER export crediting for on site generation." .

urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Rate Plan Modifier Version"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Temporal instance of a rate plan modifier with specific effective dates and prices" ;
    skos:note "Time-bound version of a rate plan modifier, parallel to RatePlanVersion structure. Versions must not overlap temporally (except drafts) and should form a continuous timeline. Contains the actual prices, credits, and adjustments for the modifier." .

urpx:RatePlanVersion a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Rate Plan Version"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Temporal instance of a rate plan with specific effective dates and prices" ;
    skos:note "Time-bound version of a rate plan. Versions must not overlap temporally (except drafts) and should form a continuous timeline. Supports lifecycle states from draft through expiration." .

urpx:RegulatoryAuthority a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Regulatory Authority"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Entity with jurisdiction to approve and regulate utility rates" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:Organization ;
    skos:note """Government or quasi-government entity with rate-setting authority.
                 Includes PUCs, FERC, international regulators with nested jurisdictions.""" .

urpx:Season a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Season"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Seasonal period definition with flexible date or month-based specifications" ;
    skos:note """Defines seasonal rate periods with a choice of 1) date-based: urpx:startDate + urpx:endDate for year-specific seasons and 2. Month-based: month (xsd:gMonth) for recurring annual patterns""" .

urpx:ServiceBracket a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Service Bracket"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Contextual boundary definition for a service tier" ;
    skos:note "Carries the actual lower and upper bounds for a ServiceTier and may optionally be qualified by season or profile alternative. A ServiceTier may have one or more ServiceBracket instances." .

urpx:ServiceClass a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Service Class"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Region-specific rate classification with raw and cleaned identifiers" ;
    skos:note """Service class identifiers as used in tariff books. Maintains both raw format
                 (as published) and cleaned format (for system use). Links prices to rate plans
                 across different contexts. Can contain multiple RateGroups for detailed organization.""" .

urpx:ServicePointProfile a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Service Point Profile"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Service delivery point characteristics for rate plan eligibility and service configuration evaluation" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:Profile ;
    skos:note """Represents the physical and technical characteristics of a utility service delivery point.""" .

urpx:ServiceTerritory a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Service Territory"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Geographic area where a utility provides service to customers" ;
    skos:note "Defines utility service area boundaries with precise geographic coverage." .

urpx:ServiceTier a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Service Tier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Logical tier identity for tiered pricing" ;
    skos:note "Defines the stable tier identity and serviceTierNumber used by prices. Actual lower and upper bounds live on attached ServiceBracket instances. Prices may reference tiers via serviceTierNumber or referencesServiceTier, or reference an exact bracket via referencesServiceBracket." .

urpx:ServiceTiers a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Service Tiers"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Container for multiple service tiers within a billing model" ;
    skos:note "Organizes multiple ServiceTier instances within a BillingModel and references the MetricInput they apply to. Container-level season and profile-alternative qualifiers remain valid and may scope all contained tiers. Name and description are allowed on the container." .

urpx:State a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "State"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "State, province, or equivalent first-level administrative division" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:AdministrativeBoundary ;
    skos:note "First-level administrative division within a country. Primary level for utility regulation in most jurisdictions." .

urpx:SupplyChargesDocument a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Supply Prices Document"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Supply prices document for competitive retail energy pricing" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:URPXDocument ;
    skos:note "Container for energy supply prices in competitive markets. CANNOT contain: RatePlans. Used in competitive retail markets for supply pricing. Complements delivery-only rate plans." .

urpx:SystemOperator a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "System Operator"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "ISO, RTO, or transmission system operator managing grid operations" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:Organization ;
    skos:note """Independent system operators and regional transmission organizations.
                 Manages wholesale markets and grid reliability for multiple jurisdictions.""" .

urpx:TOUPeriod a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Time-of-Use Period"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Specific time period with unique ID for linking to prices" ;
    skos:note "Individual time period within a tier. Aligned with utility industry TimeTariffInterval concepts. TOUPeriodNumber must be unique across entire schedule for price linking." .

urpx:TOUSchedule a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Time-of-Use Schedule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Container for time-based pricing tiers and periods with optional holiday calendar" ;
    skos:note "Defines time-varying rate structures. Aligned with utility industry TimeTariffInterval concepts. Contains TOUTiers which group periods by price level (peak, off-peak, etc.). Can be specific to measurement types." .

urpx:TOUTier a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Time-of-Use Tier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Price tier grouping TOU periods of similar pricing level (peak, mid-peak, off-peak)" ;
    skos:note "Groups TOU periods by pricing tier. TierNumber assigned in descending price order (1=highest price tier)." .

urpx:TariffAddendumDocument a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Tariff Addendum Document"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Addendum filing for corrections or clarifications" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:URPXDocument ;
    skos:note "Tariff addendum for corrections or clarifications." .

urpx:TariffBookDocument a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Tariff Book Document"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Tariff book document containing rate plans, modifiers, prices, and general rules" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:URPXDocument ;
    skos:note "Comprehensive tariff book document" .

urpx:TariffBookReference a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Tariff Book Reference"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Structured reference to a specific location within a tariff book PDF" ;
    skos:note "Nested within DataSourceReference via hasTariffBookReference. Captures leaf and page position within the PDF." .

urpx:TariffPublication a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Tariff Publication"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Formal regulatory filing" ;
    skos:note "Official regulatory filing that contains rate plan information, pricing, and rules." .

urpx:TariffStatementDocument a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Tariff Statement Document"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "PSC statement filing with prices and modifiers but no rate plans" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:URPXDocument ;
    skos:note "Tariff statement document for periodic price adjustments across customer types and rate plans. CAN contain: RatePlanModifiers. Used for periodic rate plan adjustments and fuel cost adjustments." .

urpx:TariffStatementReference a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Tariff Statement Reference"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Structured reference to a PSC statement filing PDF with provenance and statement type" ;
    skos:note "Nested within DataSourceReference via hasTariffStatementReference." .

urpx:TariffSupplementDocument a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Tariff Supplement Document"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Supplemental filing containing only rate plan modifiers" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:URPXDocument ;
    skos:note "Tariff supplement providing additional information or modifications." .

urpx:TimeBracket a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Time Bracket"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Time window definition with day type and holiday handling" ;
    skos:note "Defines when a TOU period applies. Supports complex patterns including seasons, weekday/weekend, and holiday considerations." .

urpx:URPXDocument a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "URPX Document"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Base container for all URPX content types with subclass-specific capabilities" ;
    owl:disjointWith urpx:RatePlan,
        urpx:RatePlanVersion ;
    skos:note "Root container for all URPX rate plan information. Serves as the exchange unit for rate plan data between systems. Different document types support different content capabilities." .

urpx:UtilityOperator a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Utility Operator"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Entity providing utility services and publishing rate plans" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:Organization ;
    skos:note """Actual service provider that operates infrastructure and serves customers.
                 May be electric, gas, water, or multi-service utility with specific ownership structure.""" .









# ============================================================================
# ****************    ENUMERATION CLASSES    *********************************
# ============================================================================

urpx:AccumulationValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Accumulation Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Accumulation method enumeration values for measurement aggregation" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:delta urpx:bulk urpx:instantaneous urpx:summation ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for measurement accumulation methods aligned." .

urpx:AggregationMethodValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Aggregation Method Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Aggregation method enumeration values for interval measurement processing" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:sum urpx:average urpx:maximum urpx:minimum urpx:median ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for statistical aggregation methods used in measurement interval processing." .

urpx:AnnualIncomeRangeValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Annual Income Range Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "HEAP eligibility income range enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:highIncome urpx:lowIncome urpx:middleIncome urpx:moderateIncome urpx:veryLowIncome ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for income range classification. privacy-preserving income brackets for assistance program qualification." .

urpx:AssistanceEligibilityLevelValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Assistance Eligibility Level Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Social program eligibility level enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:notQualifiedAssistance urpx:provisionallyQualifiedAssistance urpx:qualifiedAssistance urpx:underReviewAssistance ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for assistance program eligibility levels. standardized qualification definitions." .

urpx:BillPortionValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Bill Portion Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Enumeration of valid bill portion values"@en ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:bundledPortion urpx:deliveryPortion urpx:supplyPortion ) ] .

urpx:BooleanOperatorValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Boolean Operator Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Enumeration class for boolean-only operators used in condition expression trees"@en ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:andOperator urpx:notOperator urpx:orOperator ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for boolean-only operators used by BooleanOperationNode in condition expression trees." .

urpx:ChangeReasonValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Change Reason Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Regulatory filing categories enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:changeReasonOther urpx:correction urpx:fuelAdjustment urpx:initial urpx:rateCase urpx:regulatoryOrder urpx:riderUpdate urpx:seasonalChange ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for standardized change reason definitions." .

urpx:ChargeCategoryValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Charge Category Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Enumeration of valid charge category values"@en ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:adjustment urpx:auxiliaryCharge urpx:discount urpx:environmental urpx:infrastructure urpx:regulatory urpx:serviceCharge urpx:taxes ) ] .

urpx:ChargeTypeValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Charge Type Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Enumeration of specific charge type implementations"@en ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:adjustmentPowerCost urpx:adjustmentRenewable urpx:adjustmentTariff urpx:ancillaryServices urpx:capacity urpx:capacityCharge urpx:capitalCredit urpx:complianceCharge urpx:congestionCharge urpx:conservationCharge urpx:contractMisc urpx:creditAdministrative urpx:creditEnergy urpx:creditGeneration urpx:creditInfrastructure urpx:creditMisc urpx:creditPriceProtection urpx:creditRenewable urpx:creditTariffRider urpx:deliveryCharge urpx:demandDirect urpx:demandIndirect urpx:demandSideManagement urpx:depositCredit urpx:depositInterest urpx:depositRequest urpx:distributedGeneration urpx:distributionCharge urpx:donation urpx:efficiencyFunding urpx:energyStorage urpx:environmentalFunding urpx:facilities urpx:generation urpx:handling urpx:heapDiscount urpx:initiationCharge urpx:minimumBill urpx:minimumCharge urpx:nonBypassableCharge urpx:powerFactor urpx:publicBenefits urpx:recoverySurcharge urpx:reliabilityCharge urpx:renewableFunding urpx:rentalFee urpx:serviceMetered urpx:serviceNonMetered urpx:strandedCosts urpx:systemBenefitCharge urpx:tariffRider urpx:taxAdjustment urpx:taxCredit urpx:taxMisc urpx:taxMunicipal urpx:taxSales urpx:taxState urpx:taxUtility urpx:transitionCharge urpx:transmission urpx:usageCharge urpx:volumetricCharge ) ] .

urpx:CommodityValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Commodity Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Industry-standard commodity type enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:biomass urpx:cableTv urpx:chilledWater urpx:coal urpx:commodityOther urpx:compressedAir urpx:diesel urpx:districtCooling urpx:districtHeating urpx:electricity urpx:fuelOil urpx:gasoline urpx:geothermal urpx:hotWater urpx:hydroelectric urpx:internet urpx:irrigation urpx:naturalGas urpx:nonPotableWater urpx:nuclear urpx:potableWater urpx:propane urpx:recycling urpx:security urpx:sewage urpx:solar urpx:steam urpx:stormwater urpx:telecommunications urpx:wasteHeat urpx:wasteManagement urpx:water urpx:wind ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for commodity types covering energy, utilities, and telecommunications services." .

urpx:ConnectionKindValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Connection Kind Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Connection type enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:directConnection urpx:overheadConnection urpx:padMountedConnection urpx:permanentConnection urpx:temporaryConnection urpx:undergroundConnection ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for service connection types." .

urpx:ConnectorTypeValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Connector Type Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "EV connector type enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:level1 urpx:level2 urpx:dcFast urpx:teslaSupercharger urpx:chademo urpx:ccs ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for electric vehicle charging connector types affecting charging capabilities." .

urpx:CustomerChoiceValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Customer Choice Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Enrollment choice type for rate plan versions" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:voluntaryChoice urpx:mandatoryChoice ) ] ;
    skos:note "Indicates whether customer enrollment in a rate plan version is voluntary or mandatory." .

urpx:CustomerKindValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Customer Kind Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Customer classification enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:residentialKind  urpx:commercialKind  urpx:industrialKind  urpx:enterpriseKind  urpx:serviceProviderKind  urpx:internalUseKind urpx:nonResidentialKind ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for customer type classification." .

urpx:CustomerSubKindValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Customer Sub Kind Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Detailed customer classification enumeration values organized by parent kind" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:residentialStandard  urpx:residentialFarm urpx:residentialMultiUnit urpx:commercialStandard urpx:commercialStreetlight urpx:commercialPumping urpx:industrialStandard urpx:industrialLargeLoad urpx:energySupplier urpx:energyScheduler urpx:windMachine urpx:subsidiary urpx:regionalOperator urpx:religiousInstitution ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for detailed customer subcategories organized by main customer kind." .

urpx:DataSourceTypeValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Data Source Type Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Data source type enumeration values for structured references" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:apiSource urpx:databaseSource urpx:manualSource urpx:utilityWebsiteSource urpx:regulatoryWebsiteSource ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for data source types enabling better traceability and validation of price information sources." .

urpx:DayTypeValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Day Type Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "ISO 8601 day type enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:allDays urpx:customDays urpx:weekdayDays urpx:weekendDays ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for standardized day type classifications for temporal logic." .

urpx:DERTypeValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "DER Type Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Distributed energy resource type enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:solarDER urpx:storageDER urpx:evChargingDER urpx:windDER urpx:generatorDER urpx:geothermalDER urpx:wasteDigestionDER urpx:hydroDER urpx:nuclearDER ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for distributed energy resource categorization." .

urpx:DynamicPricingTypeValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Dynamic Pricing Type Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "FERC market terminology enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:criticalPeakPricing urpx:demandResponsePricing urpx:eventDrivenPricing urpx:indexBasedPricing urpx:realTimePricing urpx:timeVaryingPricing ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for dynamic pricing types. standardized market pricing terminology." .

urpx:EndUseValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "End Use Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "End use classification enumeration values for electric service" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:heatingEndUse urpx:nonheatingEndUse urpx:dataCenterEndUse urpx:spaceHeatingEndUse urpx:spaceCoolingEndUse urpx:waterHeatingEndUse urpx:cookingEndUse urpx:dryingEndUse urpx:lightingEndUse urpx:refrigerationEndUse urpx:agriculturalEndUse urpx:streetLightingEndUse urpx:municipalEndUse urpx:otherEndUse ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for electric service end use categorization covering heating, cooling, water heating, cooking, drying, lighting, refrigeration, and specific service types like agricultural or street lighting." .

urpx:EnergyServiceProvider a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Energy Service Provider"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Retail energy provider, aggregator, or energy service company" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf urpx:Organization ;
    skos:note """Competitive retail providers, community choice aggregators, ESCOs.
                 Offer rate plans and DER rate plan modifiers but typically don't own distribution infrastructure.""" .

urpx:EnrollmentStatusValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Enrollment Status Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Lifecycle states enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:activeStatus urpx:expiredStatus urpx:inactiveStatus urpx:pendingStatus urpx:suspendedStatus urpx:terminatedStatus ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for enrollment status tracking. standardized lifecycle state definitions." .

urpx:EntityTypeValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Entity Type Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Legal entity type enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:corporationEntity urpx:entityOther urpx:governmentEntity urpx:individualEntity urpx:llcEntity urpx:nonprofitEntity urpx:partnershipEntity urpx:trustEntity ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for legal entity types. standardized legal entity type definitions." .

urpx:FlowDirectionValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Flow Direction Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Flow direction enumeration values for energy flow measurement" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:forward urpx:reverse urpx:net urpx:bidirectional ) ] ;

urpx:HVACKindValue a owl:Class ;

urpx:IdentifierSchemeValue a owl:Class ;

urpx:InterconnectionStatusValue a owl:Class ;

urpx:IntervalAlignmentValue a owl:Class ;

urpx:InverterTypeValue a owl:Class ;

urpx:LedgerTypeValue a owl:Class ;

urpx:MetricInputTypeValue a owl:Class ;

urpx:ModifierCategoryValue a owl:Class ;

urpx:OrganizationTypeValue a owl:Class ;

urpx:PhaseCodeKindValue a owl:Class ;

urpx:PriceSourceValue a owl:Class ;

    skos:note "Enumeration class for dynamic pricing data sources. standardized market price source definitions." .

urpx:ProgramTypeValue a owl:Class ;

    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:demandResponseProgram urpx:energyEfficiencyProgram urpx:greenEnergyProgram urpx:lowIncomeProgram urpx:moderateIncomeProgram urpx:timeOfUseProgram urpx:communityChoiceAggregation urpx:communitySolar ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for utility program categorization. standardized program type definitions including CCA and community solar." .
    
urpx:PublicationTypeValue a owl:Class ;

    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:amendment urpx:notice urpx:order urpx:ratePlanPublication urpx:ratePlanModifierPublication urpx:regulatoryFiling urpx:supplement urpx:tariffBook urpx:tariffBookLeaves urpx:tariffStatement ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for tariff publication categorization. standardized document type definitions." .

urpx:RegulatoryScopeValue a owl:Class ;

    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:distributionRegulation urpx:environmentalRegulation urpx:marketRegulation urpx:ratesRegulation urpx:safetyRegulation urpx:transmissionRegulation ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for regulatory oversight classification with standardized regulatory scope definitions for regulatory authority categorization for energy systems" .

urpx:Scenario a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Scenario"@en ;

    skos:note "Not used within a rate plan. Used to model a scenario against which EligibilityRule conditions on RatePlanVersions can be evaluated. A Scenario holds a CustomerProfile and/or ServicePointProfile representing the subject of evaluation." .

urpx:SeasonalPatternValue a owl:Class ;

    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:flatPattern urpx:summerPeakPattern urpx:variablePattern urpx:winterPeakPattern ) ] ;

urpx:ServiceRoleValue a owl:Class ;

    skos:note "Enumeration class for utility service role indicating the type of service provided." .

urpx:SpecialNeedsStatusValue a owl:Class ;

    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:medicalEquipment urpx:disabilityAccommodation urpx:lifeSupport urpx:vulnerableCustomer urpx:noSpecialNeeds ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for special needs classification affecting rate eligibility and service priority." .

urpx:TariffStatementTypeValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Statement Type Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "PSC statement filing types enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:distributionStatement urpx:fuelAdjustmentStatement urpx:purchasedPowerStatement urpx:statementTypeOther urpx:transmissionStatement ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for statement document categorization. Standardized statement type definitions." .

urpx:TaxExemptStatusValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Tax Exempt Status Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Tax exemption status enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:exempt urpx:nonExempt urpx:partialExempt urpx:pendingVerification ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for tax exemption classifications for tax-based rate eligibility." .

urpx:TOUTierStandardNameValue a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "TOU Tier Standard Name Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Industry standard TOU tier terminology enumeration values" ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:criticalPeakTier urpx:midPeakTier urpx:offPeakTier urpx:peakTier urpx:shoulderTier urpx:superOffPeakTier urpx:superPeakTier ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enumeration class for standardized time-of-use tier naming across utilities." .

urpx:UnitOfMeasureValue a owl:Class ;

urpx:UpdateFrequencyValue a owl:Class ;

    skos:note "Enumeration class for dynamic pricing update frequencies. standardized temporal interval definitions." .

urpx:VoltageLevelValue a owl:Class ;

    owl:equivalentClass [ owl:oneOf ( urpx:secondaryVoltage urpx:primaryVoltage urpx:subTransmissionVoltage urpx:transmissionVoltage urpx:distributionVoltage ) ] ;

# ============================================================================
#  ****************    PROPERTIES    *****************************************
# ============================================================================

urpx:abbreviation a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Abbreviation"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Short form or abbreviation of name" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:OrganizationName ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Organization name abbreviations. E.g., PG&E, ConEd." .

urpx:accessURL a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Access URL"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "URL from which the data was directly accessed or downloaded" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DataSourceReference ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:note "Captures the retrieval location for provenance. Use urpx:url for the canonical document URL." .

urpx:accumulationMethod a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Accumulation Method"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "How measurement values accumulate over time" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:MetricSpecification ;
    rdfs:range urpx:AccumulationValue ;
    skos:note "Defines accumulation pattern: delta (difference), bulk (cumulative), instantaneous (snapshot), or summation (sum over period)." .

urpx:adder a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Adder"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Fixed amount added to calculated price" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
        owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Applied after multiplication for final price." .

urpx:aggregationMethod a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Aggregation Method"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Statistical method for aggregating interval measurements" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CalculationMethod ;
    rdfs:range urpx:AggregationMethodValue ;
    skos:note "Specifies how measurements are aggregated: sum, average, maximum, minimum, or median. Used with intervalDuration for interval-based calculation methods." .

urpx:alternateName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Alternate Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "An alias for the item" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Organization ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "URPX Usage: GUI-friendly short name for display purposes (e.g., 'ConEd')." .

urpx:alternativeLabel a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Alternative Label"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Human-readable label describing this alternative's profile" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PriceSetAlternative ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "E.g., 'Zone H - Low Tension - Trip 2'." .

urpx:amount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Amount"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Fixed amount for prices not based on consumption" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Price ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Fixed pricing for prices like connection fees, service prices, or flat-rate billing." .

urpx:anchorLink a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Anchor Link"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "URL or fragment identifier pointing to a specific location within a tariff book PDF" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:TariffBookReference urpx:TariffStatementReference ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:note "Deep link into a PDF section or named anchor. Typically a PDF page anchor or named destination." .

urpx:annualIncomeRange a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Annual Income Range"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Annual income range bracket (HEAP eligibility)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:AnnualIncomeRangeValue ;
    skos:note "HEAP eligibility income brackets enumeration. with standardized income range definitions for consistent assistance program qualification across utilities. Preserves privacy by using ranges instead of actual income." .

urpx:applicabilityLogic a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Applicability Logic"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Boolean logic for complex applicability rules" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ApplicabilityGroup ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Supports AND, OR, NOT operations for combining geographic and service class rules." .

urpx:applicableToRateGroup a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Applicable To Rate Group"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Rate groups this modifier or rate plan can apply to" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlan ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RateGroup ;
    skos:note "Enables applicability to specific rate groups within service classes." .

urpx:applicableToRatePlan a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Applicable To Rate Plan"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Rate plans this modifier or supply plan can be applied to" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RatePlan ;
    skos:note "Defines which rate plans are compatible with this modifier or supply plan complement. For simple modifier-to-plan associations use this property. For complex enrollment-based or conditional modifier application use hasEligibilityRule." .

urpx:applicableToRatePlanVersion a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Applicable To Rate Plan Version"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Rate plan versions this modifier can be applied to" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:RatePlanVersion ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RatePlanVersion ;
    skos:note "Defines which specific rate plan versions are compatible with this modifier version." .

urpx:appliesInSeason a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Applies In Season"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Season(s) this resource applies to" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
        owl:unionOf ( urpx:TimeBracket urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSetAlternative urpx:PriceSet urpx:ServiceTiers urpx:ServiceBracket ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Season ;
    skos:note "URI references to seasons defined in PlanElements. Enables time brackets, pricing resources, ServiceTiers groups, and ServiceBracket variants to reference seasons without nesting." .

urpx:approves a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Approves"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links regulator to approved rate plans" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RegulatoryAuthority ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RatePlan ;
    skos:note "Approval of rate plans by Regulatory authority or or other party." .

urpx:assistanceEligibilityLevel a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Assistance Eligibility Level"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Assistance program eligibility level" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:AssistanceEligibilityLevelValue ;
    skos:note "Social program eligibility levels enumeration. with standardized assistance level definitions for consistent social program qualification across utilities." .

urpx:averageMonthlyUsage a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Average Monthly Usage"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Average monthly usage in kWh" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Average monthly usage for service point profile. Used for rate plan eligibility and service tier determination." .

urpx:basedOnPrice a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Based On Price"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "References another price or price summary that this price depends on for calculation" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition ) ] ;
    rdfs:range [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceSummary ) ] ;
    skos:note "Enables price calculation dependencies. Used with multiplier/adder properties for calculation formulas." .

urpx:basePrice a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Base Price"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Base price before adjustments" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Price ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Used with multipliers/adders for dynamic calculations." .

urpx:baseQuantity a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Base Quantity"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Base quantity for per-unit pricing (e.g., 'per 2 households')" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
        owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet ) ];
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Specifies the base quantity when price is expressed as 'per X units'. For example, baseQuantity=2 with householdCount metric means 'per 2 households'. Default is 1 if not specified. Used in calculation: Total = amount × (metricValue / baseQuantity)." ;
    skos:example "baseQuantity=2 for '$100 per 2 households' means each household pays $50" .

urpx:billedDemand a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Billed Demand"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Utility-estimated demand for billing in kW" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Utility estimate of service demand used for billing. Profile characteristic (utility-assigned, not meter measurement). Distinct from measured demand (measuredMetricInput) or calculated demand (calculatedMetricInput). Used for demand-based rate tiers when actual measurement unavailable. Can be updated by utility." .

urpx:billingCycleCode a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Billing Cycle Code"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Billing cycle identifier aligned with utility billing periods",
        "Billing cycle identifier aligned with utility billing periods" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:CustomerProfile urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Identifies billing cycle using utility-determined codes (e.g., 'trip_1', 'cycle_21', 'route_A'). " .

urpx:billPortion a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Bill Portion"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Identifies which portion of the bill this charge, metric, or price set belongs to"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:ChargeTypeValue ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:BillPortionValue ;
    skos:note "Specifies whether a charge applies to delivery, supply, or bundled service. Typically defined at MetricSpecification level for consistent application across prices."@en .

urpx:booleanValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Boolean Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Boolean literal value used in a condition operand node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:boolean ;
    skos:note "Boolean literal value for condition modeling." .

urpx:buildingSquareFootage a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Building Square Footage"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Building size in square feet" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Total building area served. Profile characteristic (not meter measurement). Used for commercial rate eligibility and size-based tiered pricing. Common in commercial and industrial rate structures. Can change with building modifications." .

urpx:calculatedBasedOn a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Input Metric"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Source MetricInputs for calculated MetricInput derivation" ;
    rdfs:range urpx:MetricInput ;
    skos:note "References to source MetricInputs used in calculation. Multiple input MetricInputs can be specified. Used within calculationRule blank node." .

urpx:calculationFormula a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Calculation Formula"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Formula defining calculation logic for complex scenarios" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CalculationMethod ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Optional formula when simple multiplication isn't sufficient. Example: '(basePrice * usage) + (demandCharge * peakDemand)'." .

urpx:calculationRule a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Calculation Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Calculation rule for derived MetricInputs" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:MetricInput ;
    skos:note "Defines how calculated MetricInputs derive their values from input MetricInputs. Used for net export, aggregation, and time-shifted metrics." .

urpx:caseNumber a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Case Number"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Jurisdiction-specific identifier assigned to a rate case proceeding" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RateCase ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Required identifier for the proceeding. Format varies by jurisdiction." .

urpx:changeDescription a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Change Description"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Detailed explanation of changes" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Human-readable description of what changed and why." .

urpx:changeReason a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Change Reason"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Reason for version change (regulatory filing categories)" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ChangeReasonValue ;
    skos:note "Regulatory filing categories enumeration for version change tracking. with standardized change reason definitions." .

urpx:chargeCategory a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Charge Category"@en ;
    dcterms:description "Categorizes charges by their business function rather than their mechanical properties. Used for front-end grouping and reporting."@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Business purpose classification of a charge"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:ChargeTypeValue ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ChargeCategoryValue .

urpx:chargeType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Charge Type"@en ;
    dcterms:description "Identifies the specific type of charge implementation. Multiple chargeType values can be assigned to a single charge."@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Specific implementation type of a charge"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ChargeTypeValue .

urpx:conditionProperty a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Condition Property"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "IRI reference to the ontology property evaluated by an operand node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:ObjectOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range rdf:Property ;
    skos:note "Points to the URPX ontology property being evaluated." .

urpx:connectionKind a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Connection Kind"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Type of connection at service point" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ConnectionKindValue ;
    skos:note "Connection types enumeration. with standardized connection type definitions for consistent service connection classification across utilities." .

urpx:connectorType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Connector Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "EV connector type" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DistributedEnergyResource ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ConnectorTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Connector types: Level 1, Level 2, DC Fast, Tesla Supercharger, CHAdeMO, CCS. Affects charging capabilities." .

urpx:commodity a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Service Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Industry-standard commodity type specification" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:MetricSpecification urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:Organization ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:CommodityValue ;
    skos:note "Industry-standard commodity enumeration used throughout ontology. Consolidated single property for commodity specification at multiple levels: price specification (MetricSpecification), direct price assignment (Price, PriceSet), rate plan classification (RatePlanVersion, RatePlanModifierVersion), and organization service type (Organization). with full commodity type coverage. User-facing name: 'Service Type' for application interfaces." .

urpx:contractEffectiveDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Contract Effective Date"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Effective date and time of service agreement contract" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:AccountServiceAgreement ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;
    skos:note "ISO 8601 dateTime format required. Timezone may be inherited from document or organization level." .

urpx:contractExpirationDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Contract Expiration Date"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Expiration date and time of service agreement contract" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:AccountServiceAgreement ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;
    skos:note "ISO 8601 dateTime format required. Timezone may be inherited from document or organization level. Tracks contract validity period for rate plan eligibility." .

urpx:creditRating a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Credit Rating"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Reference to external credit rating classification" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "References external credit rating categories. Credit rating data lives in external systems for alternative credit scoring and program eligibility - URPX maintains architectural boundary by referencing external systems rather than duplicating financial customer data." .

urpx:currentPrice a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Current Price"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Current effective price" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Price ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "For dynamic pricing, represents current calculated price." .

urpx:customConditionProperty a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Custom Condition Property"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Fallback custom property identifier for custom operand nodes in human-readable language"@en ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomOperandNode ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Fallback-only property name for custom conditions when no suitable URPX property exists." .

urpx:customDimensionProperty a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Custom Dimension Property"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Fallback custom property identifier for alternative dimensions in human-readable form"@en ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:AlternativeDimension ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Fallback-only property name for alternative dimensions when no suitable URPX property exists." .

urpx:customerChoice a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Customer Choice"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Indicates whether enrollment in this rate plan version is voluntary or mandatory" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlanVersion ;
    rdfs:range urpx:CustomerChoiceValue ;
    skos:note "Optional. When absent, enrollment type is unspecified." .

urpx:cycleStartDay a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Cycle Start Day"@en ;

    rdfs:domain urpx:BillingCycle ;
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "Integer 1-31 for billing period definitions." .

urpx:dataSourceType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Data Source"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Type of source of the data" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DataSourceReference;
    rdfs:range urpx:DataSourceTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Identifies the source of the data, such as the database name or specific API endpoint. Useful for tracking data provenance." .

            owl:unionOf ( urpx:TariffPublication urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:TariffBookReference  urpx:TariffStatementReference urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:date ;
    skos:note "When regulatory authority approved this version." .

    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;

    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;

    rdfs:range xsd:date ;

urpx:dateTimeModified a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:TariffBookReference urpx:TariffStatementReference urpx:TariffPublication ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;

    rdfs:range xsd:date ;
    skos:note "Official publication or filing date for tariff documents." .

urpx:dateTimePublished a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Date Time Published"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Date and time of first broadcast/publication" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:TariffPublication urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:TariffBookReference  urpx:TariffStatementReference ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;
    skos:note "Official publication or filing date for tariff documents." .    

urpx:dateReceived a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Date Received"@en ;

    skos:note "ISO 8601 date format. Captures when the document was received, which may differ from publication or approval dates." .

urpx:dateTimeReceived a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Date Time Received"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Date and time the document was received" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:URPXDocument urpx:TariffPublication urpx:TariffBookReference urpx:TariffStatementReference ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;
    skos:note "ISO 8601 date format. Captures when the document was received, which may differ from publication or approval dates." .

urpx:dateRetrieved a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Date Retrieved"@en ;

urpx:dateTimeRetrieved a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

    rdfs:comment "Date and time on which data was retrieved";

    skos:note "ISO 8601 date format. Records the access date for provenance." .

urpx:dateTimeValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;

urpx:dateValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Date Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Date literal value used in a condition operand node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:date ;
    skos:note "Date literal value for condition modeling." .

    rdfs:range urpx:DayTypeValue ;

urpx:daylightSavingRules a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

urpx:decimalValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Decimal literal value for condition modeling." .

urpx:defaultSelectionLogic a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

urpx:derType a owl:ObjectProperty ;

urpx:description a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

            owl:unionOf ( urpx:GeneralRule urpx:EligibilityRule urpx:ConditionExpression urpx:ComparisonNode urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:TariffPublication urpx:TariffBookReference urpx:URPXDocument urpx:CalculationMethod urpx:MetricInput urpx:Ledger urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:PriceUpdateRule urpx:ApplicabilityRule urpx:OperationNode urpx:BooleanOperationNode urpx:RateCase urpx:ServiceTiers ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;

urpx:dimensionDisplayName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

    rdfs:range xsd:string ;

urpx:dimensionProperty a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Dimension Property"@en ;

    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;

urpx:durationValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Duration Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Duration literal value used in a condition operand node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:duration ;

urpx:dynamicPricingType a owl:ObjectProperty ;

    rdfs:domain urpx:DynamicPricing ;
    rdfs:range urpx:DynamicPricingTypeValue ;
    skos:note "FERC market terminology enumeration for dynamic pricing types. with standardized market pricing type definitions." .

urpx:effectiveDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Effective Date"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Date when entity becomes active" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:TariffPublication urpx:URPXDocument ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:date ;
    skos:note "ISO 8601 date format. For date-only specifications." .

urpx:effectiveDateTime a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Effective Date Time"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Date/time when entity becomes active" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:TariffPublication urpx:URPXDocument ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;
    skos:note "ISO 8601 format with timezone. Critical for version management." .

urpx:endDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "End Date"@en ;

            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet urpx:TOUPeriod urpx:BillingCycle urpx:Season ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:date ;
    skos:note "When endDate is not present, the validity period is considered open-ended until superseded or explicitly terminated." .

urpx:endDateTime a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "End Date Time"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "End date and time for validity period (with time component). Omit for indefinite validity." ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet urpx:TOUPeriod urpx:BillingCycle urpx:Season ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;
    skos:note "When endDateTime is not present, the validity period is considered open-ended until superseded or explicitly terminated." .

urpx:endTime a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

urpx:endUse a owl:ObjectProperty ;

urpx:enrollmentStartDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

            owl:unionOf ( urpx:PriorRatePlan urpx:ProgramEnrollment ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:date ;

urpx:enrollmentStatus a owl:ObjectProperty ;

            owl:unionOf ( urpx:PriorRatePlan urpx:ProgramEnrollment ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:EnrollmentStatusValue ;

urpx:entityType a owl:ObjectProperty ;

    rdfs:range urpx:EntityTypeValue ;

urpx:evChargingCapacity a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

    skos:note "Electric vehicle charging capability. Used for EV-specific rates and managed charging programs." .

urpx:expirationDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Expiration Date"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Date when entity becomes inactive" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:TariffPublication urpx:URPXDocument ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:date ;

urpx:expirationDateTime a owl:DatatypeProperty ;

    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:TariffPublication urpx:URPXDocument ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;
    skos:note "Optional but recommended for clarity. Null implies indefinite duration." .

urpx:expectedEndDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Expected End Date"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Provisional end date subject to change" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet urpx:TOUPeriod urpx:BillingCycle urpx:URPXDocument urpx:TariffPublication urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:LocationDataSet ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:date ;
    skos:note "Used when definitive end date is unknown but provisional date exists. Common for rates marked 'effective until further notice' or 'subject to review'. Does not create binding commitment - actual end may differ." .

urpx:expectedEndDateTime a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Expected End Date Time"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Provisional end date/time subject to change" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet urpx:TOUPeriod urpx:BillingCycle urpx:URPXDocument urpx:TariffPublication urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:LocationDataSet ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;
    skos:note "Provisional end date/time with timezone precision. Supports utility 'until further notice' rate patterns. ISO 8601 format with timezone." .

urpx:fileName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "File Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Name of document or file including filename extension if present." ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DataSourceReference ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string .

urpx:filingNumber a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Filing Number"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Official regulatory filing or docket number" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TariffPublication ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Unique identifier used by regulatory authority for tracking." .

urpx:flowDirection a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Flow Direction"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Direction of energy flow for measurement" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:MetricSpecification ;
    rdfs:range urpx:FlowDirectionValue ;
    skos:note "Defines flow direction: forward (consumption/import), reverse (generation/export), net (net metering), or bidirectional. Critical for DER and net metering scenarios." .

urpx:formula a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Formula"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Formula expression for calculated MetricInputs" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "String expression defining calculation logic. Example: 'generation - gridImport' for net export. Used within calculationRule blank node." .

urpx:generalRuleID a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "General Rule ID"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Unique identifier for a general rule" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:GeneralRule ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Stable identifier for referencing this rule from RatePlanVersion and RatePlanModifierVersion instances across rate plans." .

urpx:geographicScope a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Geographic Scope"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Geographic scope of applicability or eligibility (ISO 3166 admin levels)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:GeographicScopeValue ;
    skos:note "ISO 3166 admin levels enumeration for geographic scope classification with standardized administrative level definitions." .

urpx:geographicZone a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Geographic Zone"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Geographic classification (Census geographic types)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:GeographicZoneValue ;
    skos:note "Census geographic types enumeration for customer location classification. with standardized geographic zone definitions for consistent location-based analysis across utilities." .

urpx:gMonthValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "GMonth Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "gMonth literal value used in a condition operand node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:gMonth ;
    skos:note "gMonth literal value for condition modeling." .

urpx:gYearValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "GYear Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "gYear literal value used in a condition operand node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:gYear ;
    skos:note "gYear literal value for condition modeling." .

urpx:hasAlternative a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Alternative"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links alternatives container to specific price set options" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PriceSet ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ProfileAlternative ;
    skos:note "All linked PriceSets must have matching priceMatchingKey." .

urpx:hasAlternativeDimension a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Alternative Dimension"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Dimensions along which alternatives differ" ;
