    rdfs:domain urpx:AlternativeDimensions ;
    rdfs:range urpx:AlternativeDimension ;
    skos:note "Multiple dimensions create a matrix of alternatives." .

urpx:hasAlternativeDimensions a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Alternative Dimensions"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links ProfileAlternatives to its AlternativeDimensions container, which wraps the alternative dimension sets and their metadata" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ProfileAlternatives ;
    rdfs:range urpx:AlternativeDimensions ;
    skos:note "Each ProfileAlternatives has exactly one AlternativeDimensions container." .

urpx:hasApplicabilityGroup a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Applicability Group"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links price set to applicability rules" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:PriceSet urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ApplicabilityGroup ;
    skos:note "Defines geographic and service class applicability for the entire price set." .

urpx:hasApplicabilityRule a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Applicability Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Conditions for price application" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:GeneralRule ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ApplicabilityRule ;
    skos:note "Determines when price applies during billing calculation." .

urpx:hasBillingCycle a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Billing Cycle"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links Ledger to billing cycle definitions" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Ledger ;
    rdfs:range urpx:BillingCycle ;
    skos:note "Links Ledger to billing cycle definitions." .

urpx:hasBillingModel a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Billing Model"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Billing rules and calculation patterns for rate plan version" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PlanElements ;
    rdfs:range urpx:BillingModel ;
    skos:note "Defines billing calculation rules, proration patterns, and adjustment mechanisms. Separates billing concerns from pricing and temporal definitions." .

urpx:hasCalculationMethod a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Calculation Method"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links price to its calculation method" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
    owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:CalculationMethod;
    skos:note "Defines how a price is calculated." .

urpx:hasCalendar a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Calendar"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "References holiday calendar for this TOU schedule" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TOUSchedule ;
    rdfs:range urpx:HolidayCalendar ;
    skos:note "Links to document-level calendar or external calendar resource." .

urpx:hasConditionExpression a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Condition Expression"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links a rule to its structured condition expression"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:EligibilityRule urpx:ApplicabilityRule urpx:ApplicabilityGroup urpx:ProfileAlternative ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ConditionExpression ;
    skos:note "The rule-level entry point for structured condition applicability." .

urpx:hasCounty a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has County"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links service point profile to county-level geographic scope" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:County ;
    skos:note "Defines county-level eligibility and applicability through use in service point profile and within ConditionExpression." .

urpx:hasCustomerKind a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Customer Kind"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Primary customer classification" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:CustomerKindValue ;
    skos:note "Links customer profile to main customer type classification. Multiple customer kinds can be assigned to support complex customer profiles." .

urpx:hasCustomerProfile a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Customer Profile"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links scenario to customer profile for business/social characteristics" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Scenario ;
    rdfs:range urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    skos:note "Parallel property with hasServicePointProfile. Evaluates eligibility rules based on customer business, social, and program participation characteristics. Used for rate plan qualification and program eligibility." .

urpx:hasCustomerSubKind a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Customer Sub Kind"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Detailed customer classification" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:CustomerSubKindValue ;
    skos:note "Links customer profile to detailed customer subcategory classification. Multiple customer subkinds can be assigned to support complex customer profiles. with hierarchical organization under parent customer kinds." .

urpx:hasDataSourceReference a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Data Source Reference"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links an entity to a structured data source reference." ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:GeneralRule urpx:PriceSet urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSetAlternative urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:TariffBookDocument urpx:TariffPublication urpx:TariffStatementDocument urpx:EligibilityRule ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:DataSourceReference ;
    skos:note "Enables traceability for data points back to their original source files or APIs with structured metadata." .

urpx:hasDistributedEnergyResource a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Distributed Energy Resource"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Distributed energy resources associated with this service point" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:DistributedEnergyResource ;
    skos:note "Links service point to DER capabilities including solar, storage, EV charging, and wind. Supports distributed energy resource (DER) metadata including solar, storage, and EV charging." .

urpx:hasDynamicPricing a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Dynamic Pricing"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links price to dynamic pricing configuration" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Price ;
    rdfs:range urpx:DynamicPricing ;
    skos:note "Enables real-time, market-based, or event-driven pricing for the price." .

urpx:hasEligibilityRule a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Eligibility Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Customer qualification rules" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:EligibilityRule ;
    skos:note "Rules determine customer qualification for the rate plan version or rate plan modifier version." .

urpx:hasGeneralRule a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has General Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links a TariffBookDocument to its general rules" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TariffBookDocument ;
    rdfs:range urpx:GeneralRule ;
    skos:note "General rules defined at the tariff book level, shared across rate plans." .

urpx:hasHoliday a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Holiday"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Individual holidays in the calendar" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:HolidayCalendar ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Holiday ;
    skos:note "Each holiday must have either specific date or calculation rule." .

urpx:hasHolidayCalendar a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Holiday Calendar"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Holiday calendar reference for TOU calculations, versioned location data, or centralized temporal definitions" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:LocationDataSet urpx:PlanElements ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:HolidayCalendar ;
    skos:note "Can be referenced at RatePlanVersion level for direct selection, contained within LocationDataSet for versioned bundling, or within PlanElements. All approaches supported for flexibility." .

urpx:hasHVAC a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has HVAC"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "HVAC equipment associated with this service point" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:HVACKindValue ;
    skos:note "Links service point to HVAC equipment including heat pumps and space heaters." .

urpx:hasIdentifier a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Identifier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links identity to external identifiers" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:OrganizationIdentity ;
    rdfs:range urpx:OrganizationIdentifier ;
    skos:note "External organization identifiers. E.g., EIA ID, DUNS, LEI." .

urpx:hasIdentity a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Identity"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links organization to temporal identity records" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Organization ;
    rdfs:range urpx:OrganizationIdentity ;
    skos:note "Temporal identity tracking for organization names and identifiers over time." .

urpx:hasJurisdictionOver a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Jurisdiction Over"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links regulator to regulated entities" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RegulatoryAuthority ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Organization ;
    skos:note "Regulatory authority jurisdiction over organizations." .

urpx:hasLedger a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Ledger"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links plan elements to ledgers for billing segregation" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:BillingModel ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Ledger ;
    skos:note "Enables multiple ledgers for separation of supply vs delivery charges. At least one ledger required. Ledgers reference MetricInputs (many-to-many)." .

urpx:hasLocationDataSet a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Location Data Set"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links organization to versioned location auxiliary data" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Organization urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanModifier ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:LocationDataSet ;
    skos:note "Organizations publish versioned LocationDataSet instances containing holidays, timezone, and DST rules. Multiple versions can exist for temporal evolution." .

urpx:hasMeteringConfiguration a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Metering Configuration"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Metering configuration type" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:MeteringConfigurationValue ;
    skos:note "Metering types: net, interval, demandConfiguration, prepaid, ami, manual. Affects billing and rate application." .

urpx:hasMetricInput a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Metric Input"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links plan elements to metric inputs for measurement organization" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PlanElements ; 
    rdfs:range urpx:MetricInput ;
    skos:note "Supports measured MetricInputs (raw meter data) and calculated MetricInputs (derived metrics)." .

urpx:hasMetricSpecification a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Metric Specification"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Defines measurement specifications for prices or pricing model components" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:MetricInput ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:MetricSpecification ;
    skos:note "Defines what is being measured. Supports two complementary usage patterns: Multiple prices reference same MetricSpec IRI via hasMetricSpecification or embed in Price or PriceSet." .

urpx:hasModifierOptions a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Modifier Options"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links rate plan version to its available modifier options" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlanVersion ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RatePlanModifier ;
    skos:note "A RatePlanVersion may have zero or more associated RatePlanModifiers representing optional modifiers that can be applied to the base rate plan." .

urpx:hasModifierVersionOptions a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Modifier Version Options"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Modifier versions available as options for this rate plan version" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlanVersion ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ;
    skos:note "Links a rate plan version to one or more applicable rate plan modifier versions for version level option modeling." .

urpx:hasMunicipality a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Municipality"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links service point profile to municipality-level geographic scope" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Municipality ;
    skos:note "Defines municipality-level eligibility and applicability through use in service point profile and within ConditionExpression. Most specific geographic level." .

urpx:hasName a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links identity to organization names" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:OrganizationIdentity ;
    rdfs:range urpx:OrganizationName ;
    skos:note "Organization names with type, language, and canonical/preferred status." .

urpx:hasPlanElements a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Plan Elements"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Centralized temporal and pricing elements for rate plan or modifier versions" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PlanElements ;
    skos:note "Links version to centralized container for seasons, holiday calendars, and metric-specific pricing rule sets. Shared architecture between RatePlanVersion and RatePlanModifierVersion for unified pricing structure." .
    
urpx:hasPossibleValues a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Possible Values"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "List of possible values" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:AlternativeDimension ;
    rdfs:range rdf:List ;
    skos:note """List of objects for possible values.""" .

urpx:hasPrice a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Price"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links price set to individual prices" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:PriceSet urpx:Prices ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Price ;
    skos:note "Each price must have unique combination of type and conditions within set." .

urpx:hasPriceDefinition a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Price Definition"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links a billing model to its price definitions." ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:BillingModel ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PriceDefinition ;
    skos:note "Owned at the BillingModel level. Each PriceDefinition declares its associated Ledger via urpx:referencesLedger." .

urpx:hasPrices a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Prices"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links rate plan version to actual price instances with rate values" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
        owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:TariffStatementDocument urpx:TariffSupplementDocument urpx:TariffAddendumDocument ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Prices ;
    skos:note "Two-tier Price architecture: Tier 2 instances contain actual unitPrice/amount values and temporal validity. Reference price definitions for calculation structure." .

urpx:hasPriceSet a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Price Set"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links Prices container to base/default price sets" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Prices ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PriceSet ;
    skos:note "A Prices container may have zero or more base price sets. Property now lives on Prices container instead of directly on RatePlanVersion for better organization. Alternative price sets use hasPriceSetAlternatives instead." .

urpx:hasPriceSetAlternative a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Price Set Alternative Member"@en ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PriceSetAlternatives ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PriceSetAlternative ;
    rdfs:comment "Links PriceSetAlternatives container to individual PriceSetAlternative instances." ;
    skos:note "The inverse of hasPriceSetAlternatives." .

urpx:hasPriceSetAlternatives a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Price Set Alternatives Container"@en ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Prices ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PriceSetAlternatives ;
    rdfs:comment "Links Prices container directly to PriceSetAlternatives instances for mutually exclusive price set options." ;
    skos:note "A Prices container may have zero or more PriceSetAlternatives instances. Each PriceSetAlternatives container references its ProfileAlternatives definition via forProfileAlternatives property and each alternative references its ProfileAlternative via forProfileAlternative property." .

urpx:hasPriceSummary a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Price Summary"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links price set to summary totals" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PriceSet ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PriceSummary ;
    skos:note "Summary prices that aggregate line items." .

urpx:hasPriceUpdateRule a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Price Update Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Rules governing price updates" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DynamicPricing ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PriceUpdateRule ;
    skos:note "Multiple rules can exist with priority ordering for evaluation." .

urpx:hasPriorRatePlan a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Prior Rate Plan"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links customer profile to previous rate plan enrollment" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PriorRatePlan ;
    skos:note "Used for eligibility rules based on rate plan history." .

urpx:hasProfileAlternative a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Profile Alternative"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links ProfileAlternatives container to individual ProfileAlternative instances, each representing one mutually exclusive alternative choice configuration" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ProfileAlternatives ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ProfileAlternative ;
    skos:note "At least two alternatives required for meaningful choice. Each ProfileAlternative defines dimension-value pairs characterizing one alternative option." .

urpx:hasProfileAlternatives a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Profile Alternatives"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links plan elements to profile alternatives requiring user selection of mutually exclusive options" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PlanElements ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ProfileAlternatives ;
    skos:note "At most one ProfileAlternatives per PlanElements. Optional for rate plans without user-selectable alternatives." .

urpx:hasProgramEnrollment a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Program Enrollment"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links customer profile to program enrollments" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ProgramEnrollment ;
    skos:note "Used for eligibility rules based on program participation." .

urpx:hasRateCase a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Rate Case"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links a rate plan version or pricing artifact to one or more associated rate case proceedings" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet urpx:PriceSetAlternative ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RateCase ;
    skos:note "Used to associate versions and pricing artifacts with the formal rate case proceedings that establish or revise them." .

urpx:hasRateGroup a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Rate Group"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links rate plan to specific rate group",
        "Links service class to specific rate groups" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlan  urpx:ServiceClass ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RateGroup ;
    skos:note "Enables service class to contain multiple rate groups (e.g., Rate I, Rate II).",
        "Rate plans can reference rate groups directly for precise classification" .

urpx:hasRatePlan a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Rate Plan"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links document to rate plans" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:URPXDocument ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RatePlan ;
    skos:note "Can contain multiple rate plans in a single document." .

urpx:hasRatePlanModifier a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Rate Plan Modifier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Rate plan modifiers available in this document" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:URPXDocument ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RatePlanModifier ;
    skos:note "Optional add-ons or adjustments that can be applied across rate plans." .

urpx:hasRatePlanModifierVersion a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Rate Plan Modifier Version"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links modifier to its temporal versions" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlanModifier ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ;
    skos:note "Versions must not overlap (except drafts) and should provide continuous coverage." .

urpx:hasRatePlanVersion a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Rate Plan Version"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links rate plan to its temporal versions" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlan ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RatePlanVersion ;
    skos:note "Versions must not overlap (except drafts) and should provide continuous coverage." .

urpx:hasSeasons a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Seasons"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Seasonal definitions for rate plan or modifier version" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PlanElements ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Season ;
    skos:note "Defines seasons once in PlanElements, eliminating redundancy. Seasons are referenced by TimeBrackets via appliesInSeason property. Shared by both rate plan and modifier versions." .

urpx:hasServiceBracket a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Service Bracket"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Contextual boundary variants attached to a service tier" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServiceTier ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ServiceBracket ;
    skos:note "Attach one or more ServiceBracket instances to a ServiceTier. Each ServiceBracket carries the actual lower and upper bounds and any optional season or profile-alternative qualifiers." .

urpx:hasServiceClass a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Service Class"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Service classes applicable to this rate plan" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanModifier ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ServiceClass ;
    skos:note "Links rate plan to region-specific service class identifiers." .

urpx:hasServicePointProfile a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Service Point Profile"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links scenario to service point profile for physical service delivery characteristics" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Scenario ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    skos:note "Parallel property with hasCustomerProfile. Evaluates eligibility rules based on physical service point characteristics. Used for rate plan qualification and price selection based on service delivery point attributes." .

urpx:hasServiceTerritory a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Applies In Service Territory"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links service point profile to service territory geographic scope" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ServiceTerritory ;
    skos:note "Defines utility service territory eligibility and applicability through use in service point profile and within ConditionExpression." .

urpx:hasServiceTier a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Service Tier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Logical service tier definitions for tiered pricing structures" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServiceTiers ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ServiceTier ;
    skos:note "Defines the logical service tiers available within a ServiceTiers container. Actual lower and upper bounds live on ServiceBracket instances attached to each ServiceTier." .

urpx:hasServiceTiers a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Service Tiers"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Container for multiple service tier definitions" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:BillingModel ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ServiceTiers ;
    skos:note "Enables definition of multiple service tiers within a billing model for complex tiered pricing structures." .

urpx:hasState a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Applies In State"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links service point profile to state-level geographic scope" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:State ;
    skos:note "Defines state-level eligibility and applicability through use in service point profile and within ConditionExpression." .

urpx:hasTariffBookReference a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Tariff Book Reference"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links a DataSourceReference to tariff book sections" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DataSourceReference ;
    rdfs:range urpx:TariffBookReference ;
    skos:note "Links DataSourceReference to tariff book leaf identifiers." .

urpx:hasTariffPublication a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Tariff Publication"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "References to formal tariff publications" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:URPXDocument ;
    rdfs:range urpx:TariffPublication ;
    skos:note "Links to official tariff documents, PDFs, or regulatory filings." .

urpx:hasTariffStatementReference a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Tariff Statement Reference"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links a DataSourceReference to a structured tariff statement filing reference" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DataSourceReference ;
    rdfs:range urpx:TariffStatementReference ;
    skos:note "Allows structured provenance and statement type metadata on regulatory filing citations." .

urpx:hasTimeBracket a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has Time Bracket"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Defines when TOU period applies" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TOUPeriod ;
    rdfs:range urpx:TimeBracket ;
    skos:note "Multiple brackets allow complex schedules (e.g., different weekday/weekend times)." .

urpx:hasTOUPeriod a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has TOU Period"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links TOU tier to specific time periods" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TOUTier ;
    rdfs:range urpx:TOUPeriod ;
    skos:note "Periods within a tier share similar pricing characteristics." .

urpx:hasTOUSchedule a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has TOU Schedule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Defines time-of-use pricing schedules" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:BillingModel ;
    rdfs:range urpx:TOUSchedule ;
    skos:note "Enables multiple TOU schedules per MetricSpecification for clean price referencing." .

urpx:hasTOUTier a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Has TOU Tier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links TOU schedule to pricing tiers (peak, mid-peak, off-peak)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TOUSchedule ;
    rdfs:range urpx:TOUTier ;
    skos:note "Tiers organize time-of-use periods by price level for clearer structure." .

urpx:holidayDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Holiday Date"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Specific date for fixed holidays" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Holiday ;
    rdfs:range xsd:date ;
    skos:note "Use for holidays with fixed dates (e.g., 2025-01-01)." .

urpx:holidayName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Holiday Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Name of the holiday" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Holiday ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Human-readable holiday name (e.g., 'New Year's Day')." .

urpx:holidayRule a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Holiday Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Rule for calculating holiday date" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Holiday ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Use for calculated holidays (e.g., 'third Monday in February')." .

urpx:householdCount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Household Count"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Number of households served by this customer account" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "Used for per-household rate calculations and credits like California Climate Credit. Typically 1 for single-family residential, but can be >1 for multi-unit buildings with master-metered service or community solar arrangements. Distinct from householdSize (number of people in household) and occupancyCount (people at premises)." .

urpx:householdSize a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Household Size"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Number of people in household (HEAP eligibility)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "Household size for HEAP and other assistance program eligibility. Range typically 1-10+ persons. Privacy-preserving." .

urpx:identifierJurisdiction a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Identifier Jurisdiction"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Jurisdiction where identifier is valid" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:OrganizationIdentifier ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Jurisdiction where identifier is valid. Country or region code." .

urpx:identifierScheme a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Identifier Scheme"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Identification scheme or system (Standard ID systems)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:OrganizationIdentifier ;
    rdfs:range urpx:IdentifierSchemeValue ;
    skos:note "Standard ID systems enumeration. Standardized identifier scheme definitions for international systems." .

urpx:identityValidFrom a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Identity Valid From"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Start date for this identity record" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:OrganizationIdentity ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;
    skos:note "Identity record effective date." .

urpx:identityValidTo a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Identity Valid To"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "End date for this identity record" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:OrganizationIdentity ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;
    skos:note "Identity record expiration date. Null if current identity." .

urpx:includeHolidays a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Includes Holidays"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Whether this bracket applies on holidays" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TimeBracket ;
    rdfs:range xsd:boolean ;
    skos:note "True if bracket applies on holidays, false otherwise." .

urpx:includeNonHolidays a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Includes Non Holidays"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Whether this bracket applies on non-holidays" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TimeBracket ;
    rdfs:range xsd:boolean ;
    skos:note "True if bracket applies on non-holidays, false otherwise." .

urpx:includesPrice a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Includes Price"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Prices included in this summary for aggregation" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PriceSummary ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Price ;
    skos:note "AGGREGATION semantics: References prices being summed into this summary total/subtotal. Use for creating totals like 'Total Delivery Prices' from multiple delivery line items. Distinct from basedOnPrice which has CALCULATION INPUT semantics (prices used in formulas). Explicit reference avoids double counting in billing calculations." .

urpx:initialEffectiveDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Initial Effective Date"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Date when this rate plan was first introduced" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanModifier ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:date ;
    skos:note "Tracks the original introduction date of the rate plan, independent of version changes." .

urpx:integerValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Integer Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Integer literal value used in a condition operand node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "Integer literal value for condition modeling." .

urpx:interconnectionStatus a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Interconnection Status"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Grid interconnection status" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DistributedEnergyResource ;
    rdfs:range urpx:InterconnectionStatusValue ;
    skos:note "DER interconnection status enumeration. with standardized interconnection status definitions for consistent DER rate eligibility across utilities." .

urpx:intervalAlignment a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Interval Alignment"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Defines how the interval time window is anchored (e.g., rolling-to-date, billing-cycle-aligned, calendar-aligned)." ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:BillingCycle urpx:CalculationMethod urpx:MetricSpecification ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:IntervalAlignmentValue ;
    skos:note "Anchors the temporal boundary of the MetricSpecification's measurement period. For instance, billing-period-aligned vs. rolling-aligned." .

urpx:intervalDuration a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Interval Duration"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "ISO 8601 duration for the interval. Primary specification for the time window length." ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:BillingCycle urpx:CalculationMethod urpx:MetricSpecification ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:duration ;
    skos:note "ISO 8601 duration (e.g., P1M, P7D, PT15M). Required property on BillingCycle and MetricSpecification when defining interval for eligibility or calculation. Duration is the primary specification for interval length." .

urpx:intervalSelection a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Interval Selection"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Defines how the time window data is selected or aggregated for the interval (e.g., rolling, consecutive periods, fixed period)." ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:BillingCycle urpx:CalculationMethod urpx:MetricSpecification ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:IntervalSelectionValue ;
    skos:note "Used to define complex lookback periods for MetricSpecification, such as a 'rolling 12-month average' (in combination with intervalDuration P12M) or '3 consecutive months' for eligibility constraints." .

urpx:intervalType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Interval Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Semantic type label for the interval (optional)" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:BillingCycle urpx:CalculationMethod urpx:MetricSpecification ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:IntervalTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Optional semantic label (e.g., monthlyInterval) for human readability. Required only when interval is customInterval." .

urpx:inverterType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Inverter Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Solar inverter type" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DistributedEnergyResource ;
    rdfs:range urpx:InverterTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Inverter types: string, micro, power optimizer, central, hybrid. Affects grid interaction and requirements." .

urpx:isCanonical a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Is Canonical"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Whether this is the official/canonical name" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:OrganizationName ;
    rdfs:range xsd:boolean ;
    skos:note "Official canonical name designation. Typically the legal registered name." .    

urpx:isCCACustomer a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Is CCA Customer"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Whether the customer is served by a Community Choice Aggregator" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:boolean ;
    skos:note "Specifically for California IOU rate plans where CCA customers have different billing components." .

urpx:isCommunitySolarCustomer a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Is Community Solar Customer"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Whether the customer participates in a community solar program" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:boolean ;
    skos:note "Enables eligibility and billing calculations for community solar participants." .

urpx:isDefault a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Is Default"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Indicates this rate plan version is the default selection" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlanVersion ;
    rdfs:range xsd:boolean ;
    skos:note "True if this version is the default rate plan version for new or unspecified enrollments." .

urpx:isPreferred a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Is Preferred"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Whether this name is preferred for display" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:OrganizationName ;
    rdfs:range xsd:boolean ;
    skos:note "Preferred display name indicator." .

urpx:issuingAuthority a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Issuing Authority"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Organization that issued or approved the publication" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TariffPublication ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "E.g., utility name, public service commission, regulatory agency." .

urpx:leafEnd a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Leaf End"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Last leaf number in the tariff book for the referenced content" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:TariffBookReference urpx:TariffStatementReference ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Leaf numbers may be alphanumeric." .

urpx:leafStart a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Leaf Start"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "First leaf number in the tariff book for the referenced content" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:TariffBookReference urpx:TariffStatementReference ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Leaf numbers may be alphanumeric (e.g. '2a', 'L-1'). Distinct from PDF page numbers captured in pageStart on DataSourceReference." .

urpx:ledgerType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Ledger Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Type of ledger for billing segregation" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Ledger ;
    rdfs:range urpx:LedgerTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Identifies ledger purpose: supply, delivery, transmission, distribution, or bundled." .

urpx:leftOperand a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Left Operand"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Left operand for ordered comparison or nested operation evaluation"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:ComparisonNode urpx:OperationNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:ObjectOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode urpx:OperationNode ) ] ;
    skos:note "Used on ComparisonNode and OperationNode only." .

urpx:legalName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Legal Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Official legal name of the organization" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Organization ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Official legal utility name including corporate designations (Inc., LLC)." .

urpx:loadProfile a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Load Profile"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Load profile classification" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:LoadProfileValue ;
    skos:note "Load characteristics: baseload, peaking, variable, seasonal, intermittent, other. Used for rate plan matching." .

urpx:logicExpression a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Logic Expression"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Optional textual expression attached to a comparison or boolean operation node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:ComparisonNode urpx:BooleanOperationNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Optional node-level expression text. It supplements the structured condition graph and does not replace hasConditionExpression rootNode or operandNodes." .
    
urpx:lowerBound a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Lower Bound"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Lower threshold value for bracket applicability" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServiceBracket ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Minimum value for this service bracket. Used with lowerBoundOperator to determine boundary comparison logic." .

urpx:lowerBoundOperator a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Lower Bound Operator"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Comparison operator for lower bound evaluation" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServiceBracket ;
    rdfs:range urpx:OperatorValue ;
    skos:note "Use greaterThanOrEqualOperator for inclusive lower bounds or greaterThanOperator for exclusive lower bounds." .

urpx:measurementKind a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Measurement Kind"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Kind of measurement being performed" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:MetricSpecification ;
    rdfs:range urpx:MeasurementTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Specifies what is being measured: energy, demand, power, current, voltage, powerFactor, frequency, pressure, temperature, volume, or volumetricFlow. Used in MetricSpecification for price measurement specifications." .

urpx:mediaType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Media Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Document media type as published by IANA." ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DataSourceReference ;
    rdfs:range urpx:MediaTypeValue ;
    skos:note "See https://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types for more information." .

urpx:meterCount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Meter Count"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Count of meters at service point" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "Number of meters installed at service delivery point. Profile characteristic (not meter measurement). Used for per-meter charges and multi-meter service configurations. Can change when meters added/removed." .

urpx:metricInputType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Metric Input Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Type of MetricInput for measurement organization" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:MetricInput ;
    rdfs:range urpx:MetricInputTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Specifies metricInput type: measured (raw meter data), calculated (derived metrics), profile (profile properties), aggregated (sum of MetricInputs), or virtual (synthetic for billing)." .

urpx:minimumTenure a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Minimum Tenure"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "The minimum duration a customer must remain enrolled in a rate plan, program, or service offering."@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:PriorRatePlan urpx:ProgramEnrollment ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:duration ;
    skos:definition "Specifies the minimum contract period or commitment duration required for a rate plan, rate plan modifier, or program, expressed as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g., 'P12M' for 12 months)."@en ;
    skos:example "P12M (12 months), P1Y (1 year), P6M (6 months)"@en .

urpx:modifierCategory a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Modifier Category"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Category of modifier for organization (Business categorization)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ModifierCategoryValue ;
    skos:note "Business categorization enumeration for rate plan modifier organization. with standardized category definitions." .

urpx:modifierUniqueIdentifier a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Modifier Unique Identifier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Unique modifier identifier using alphanumeric and hyphen only" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlanModifier ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Must match pattern ^[A-Z0-9-]+$ for system compatibility." .

urpx:modifierType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Modifier Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Type of rate plan modifier (Utility rate modifiers)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ModifierTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Utility rate modifiers enumeration for rate plan modifier categorization. with standardized modifier type definitions for consistent rate plan enhancement across utilities." .

urpx:modifierVersionNumber a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Modifier Version Number"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Modifier version number" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Semantic versioning for modifier changes." .

urpx:month a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Month"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Month when this season applies (ISO 8601 gMonth format)" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Season urpx:ApplicabilityRule ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:gMonth ;
    skos:note "ISO 8601 gMonth format (--01 through --12). Use multiple property values for seasons spanning multiple months. Aligned with iCalendar RFC 5545 BYMONTH pattern. Example: Summer season with three values: --06, --07, --08." .

urpx:multiplier a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Multiplier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Multiplication factor for price calculations" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Applied to base price or price amount." .

urpx:name a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "The name of the item" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:GeneralRule urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet urpx:PriceSetAlternatives urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSummary urpx:TariffPublication urpx:TOUPeriod urpx:URPXDocument urpx:CalculationMethod urpx:MetricInput urpx:Ledger urpx:OrganizationName urpx:ProfileAlternatives urpx:ProfileAlternative urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:EligibilityRule urpx:TOUSchedule urpx:ServiceTier urpx:ServiceTiers urpx:ApplicabilityRule urpx:ApplicabilityGroup urpx:PriceUpdateRule urpx:ConditionExpression urpx:ComparisonNode urpx:RateCase ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Human-readable name for entities. Keep concise for display purposes (max 255 chars recommended). Universal naming property used across all entity types." .

urpx:nameType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Name Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Classification of name usage (entity naming)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:OrganizationName ;
    rdfs:range urpx:NameTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Entity naming enumeration. Standardized name categorization." .

urpx:nominalVoltage a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Nominal Voltage"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Nominal service voltage in volts" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Service voltage level in volts. E.g., 120, 240, 480, 13800, 69000. Used for voltage-based rate classification." .

urpx:observanceRule a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Observance Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "How the holiday is observed when it falls on weekends (government holiday standards)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Holiday ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ObservanceRuleValue ;
    skos:note "Government holiday standards enumeration for weekend observance rules. with standardized holiday observance handling." .

urpx:observesHoliday a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Observes Holiday"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Specific holidays observed by this rate plan version" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlanVersion ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Holiday ;
    skos:note "Enables rate plans to reference specific holidays by name for GUI/API access (option B). Allows selection of subset from calendar. Dates retrieved from holiday calendar for given time series." .

urpx:occupancyCount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Occupancy Count"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Number of occupants at premises" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "Count of people residing or working at premises. Profile characteristic (not meter measurement). Used for per-capita rate calculations and assistance program eligibility. Can change as occupancy changes. Privacy-preserving alternative to detailed household composition." .

urpx:operandNodes a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Operand Nodes"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Child condition nodes used by a BooleanOperationNode"@en ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:BooleanOperationNode ;
    rdfs:range [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf (
                urpx:ConditionNode
                urpx:ComparisonNode
                urpx:BooleanOperationNode
            ) ] ;
    skos:note "AND and OR use two or more operandNodes. NOT uses exactly one operandNode." .

urpx:operatesIn a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Operates In"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links organization to ISO/RTO markets" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Organization ;
    rdfs:range urpx:SystemOperator ;
    skos:note "ISO/RTO wholesale markets where organization operates." .

urpx:operator a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Operator"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "References the operator used by a comparison boolean-operation or nested operation node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf (
                urpx:ComparisonNode
                urpx:BooleanOperationNode
                urpx:OperationNode
            ) ] ;
    rdfs:range [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf (
                urpx:BooleanOperatorValue
                urpx:OperatorValue
            ) ] ;
    skos:note "Allowed operator subsets are constrained by SHACL for each node type." .

urpx:organizationType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Organization Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Classification of organization type (organization types)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Organization ;
    rdfs:range urpx:OrganizationTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Organization types enumeration. Standardized entity categorization for energy sector systems." .

urpx:ownershipType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Ownership Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Ownership structure of utility (EIA ownership categories)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:UtilityOperator ;
    rdfs:range urpx:OwnershipTypeValue ;
    skos:note "EIA ownership categories enumeration. Standardized utility business structure categorization aligned with EIA Form 861 reporting standards." .

urpx:pageReference a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Page Reference"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Page numbers or sections where rate plan information appears" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TariffPublication ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "E.g., 'Pages 15-18', 'Section 3.2', 'Schedule A-1'. Supports PDF extraction." .

urpx:pageEnd a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Page End"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Ending page number in the source document" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:TariffBookReference urpx:TariffStatementReference ) ];
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "PDF or document page number. Use leafStart/leafEnd on TariffBookReference for tariff book leaf numbers." .

urpx:pageStart a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Page Start"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Starting page number in the source document" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:TariffBookReference urpx:TariffStatementReference ) ];
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "PDF or document page number. Use leafStart/leafEnd on TariffBookReference for tariff book leaf numbers." .

urpx:panelOrientation a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Panel Orientation"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Solar panel orientation" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DistributedEnergyResource ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PanelOrientationValue ;
    skos:note "Panel orientations: south, southeast, southwest, east, west, north, tracking, multiple. Affects generation profiles." .

urpx:parentServiceClass a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Parent Service Class"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Parent service class for this rate group" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RateGroup ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ServiceClass ;
    skos:note "Links rate group to its containing service class." .

urpx:phaseCodeKind a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Phase Code Kind"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Phase code classification" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:ServicePointProfile urpx:MetricSpecification ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PhaseCodeKindValue ;
    skos:note "Phase code enumeration with standardized phase code definitions for consistent electrical service classification and measurement specification across utilities." .

urpx:powerRating a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Power Rating"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Power rating for charging/discharging in kW" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DistributedEnergyResource ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Maximum power rating for charging and discharging. Affects grid interaction capabilities." .

urpx:premiseType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Premise Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Type of premise served" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PremiseTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Premise classifications: single family, multi family, office, retail, manufacturing, warehouse, school, hospital, other." .

urpx:priceCurrency a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Price Currency"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "ISO 4217 three-letter currency code" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:URPXDocument urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "URPX Usage: Three-letter ISO 4217 code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Dual-level currency architecture: Document level (RatePlan, RatePlanVersion, URPXDocument)  all prices inherit. Price/PriceSet level for international analysis - explicit currency for cross-currency comparison. Override pattern: Price-level currency takes precedence when both present." .

urpx:priceMatchingKey a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Price Matching Key"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Key for identifying equivalent prices across alternatives" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
        owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:PriceSetAlternatives ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Format: {billPortion}:{chargeCategory}:{chargeType}:{measurementType} Example: 'supply:usage:market:energy' Used to group PriceSets into alternatives." .

urpx:priceCeiling a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Price Ceiling"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Maximum allowed price" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DynamicPricing ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Prevents prices from exceeding this threshold." .

urpx:priceFloor a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Price Floor"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Minimum allowed price" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DynamicPricing ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Prevents prices from going below this threshold." .

urpx:priceSource a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Price Source"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Source of dynamic price information (FERC market sources)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DynamicPricing ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PriceSourceValue ;
    skos:note "FERC market sources enumeration for dynamic pricing data sources. with standardized market price source definitions." .

urpx:primaryChargeType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Primary Charge Type"@en ;
    dcterms:description "Required when a charge has multiple chargeType values. Indicates the most important or representative type."@en ;
    rdfs:comment "The primary charge type when multiple types apply"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet ) ];
    rdfs:range urpx:ChargeTypeValue .

urpx:priority a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Priority"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Priority for overlapping entities" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:TOUPeriod urpx:PriceUpdateRule urpx:RateCase ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "1 = highest priority, higher numbers = lower priority." .

urpx:prorationMethod a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Proration Method"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Method for prorating prices during partial billing periods" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:BillingModel ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Defines how prices are prorated when service starts/ends mid-period. Aligned with schema.org billingDuration pattern for temporal billing allocation." .

urpx:profileMetricProperty a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Profile Metric Property"@en ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:MetricInput ;
    rdfs:range rdf:Property ;
    rdfs:comment "IRI reference to the profile property this metric uses" ;
    skos:note "Used when metricInputType is profileMetricInput. Points to properties like urpx:meterCount, urpx:buildingSquareFootage, urpx:voltageLevel. Enables MetricInput to reference profile characteristics for calculations. Required when metricInputType=profileMetricInput)." .

urpx:programName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Program Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Name of the utility program" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ProgramEnrollment ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "E.g., 'Demand Response', 'Green Energy', 'Low Income Assistance'." .

urpx:programType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Program Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Category of utility program" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ProgramEnrollment ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ProgramTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Program types enumeration for utility program categorization. with standardized program type definitions." .

urpx:publicationType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Publication Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Type of tariff publication document (Regulatory document types)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TariffPublication ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PublicationTypeValue ;
    skos:note "Regulatory document types enumeration for tariff publication categorization. with standardized publication type definitions." .

urpx:publishedBy a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Published By"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Organization that publishes this rate plan version or rate plan modifier version" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Organization ;
    skos:note "Links rate plan version and rate plan modifier version to publishing organization. Enables organization-level properties (utilityId, officialName, displayName) to be referenced rather than duplicated. Organizations published as separate URPXDocument instances for modularity." .

urpx:publishes a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Publishes"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links organization to rate plans it publishes" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Organization ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RatePlan ;
    skos:note "Rate plans published by organization." .

urpx:ratedPowerCapacity a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Rated Power Capacity"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Rated power capacity in kW" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Maximum rated power capacity of the service connection. Used for capacity-based rate eligibility." .

urpx:rateGroupIdentifier a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Rate Group Identifier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Unique identifier for the rate group" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RateGroup ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "E.g., 'SC2-RATE-I', 'SC2-RATE-II' for system processing." .

urpx:rateGroupName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Rate Group Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Human-readable name for the rate group" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RateGroup ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "E.g., 'Rate I', 'Rate II' as used in regulatory filings." .

urpx:ratePlanUniqueIdentifier a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Rate Plan Unique Identifier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Unique rate plan identifier using alphanumeric and hyphen only" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RatePlan ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Must match pattern ^[A-Z0-9-]+$ for system compatibility." .

urpx:referencesGeneralRule a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "References General Rule"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "References a general rule applicable to this rate plan version or modifier version" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:GeneralRule ;
    skos:note "Links a versioned rate plan or modifier to one or more tariff book-level general rules that apply to it." .

urpx:referencesLedger a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "References Ledger"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links a PriceDefinition to its associated Ledger." ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PriceDefinition ;
    rdfs:range urpx:Ledger ;
    skos:note "Required on every PriceDefinition. Cardinality enforced to exactly one via SHACL." .

urpx:referencesMetricInput a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "References Metric Input"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links to metric inputs for measurement and profile metric input definitions" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:AlternativeDimension urpx:Ledger urpx:TOUSchedule urpx:ServiceTiers urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:ObjectOperandNode urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:MetricInput ;
    skos:note "Many-to-many relationship between ledgers/TOU schedules/service tiers and MetricInputs. Ledgers reference MetricInputs rather than containing them. TOU schedules link to the metric input they apply to. In the condition model, ObjectOperandNode may use referencesMetricInput directly. DatatypeOperandNode and CustomOperandNode may use referencesMetricInput only on branches that also carry exactly one datatype-specific literal value property." .

urpx:referencesPriceDefinition a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "References Price Definition"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "IRI reference linking a Price, PriceSet, or PriceSetAlternative instance to its PriceDefinition" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet urpx:PriceSetAlternative ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:PriceDefinition ;
    skos:note "IRI-based reference from Price, PriceSet, or PriceSetAlternative to PriceDefinition. PriceDefinitions are owned at the BillingModel level via hasPriceDefinition; use referencesLedger on PriceDefinition to determine ledger association. Supports n:1 relationship between Price instances and their price definition." .

urpx:referencesProfileAlternative a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "References Profile Alternative"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:PriceSetAlternative urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:TOUSchedule urpx:ServiceTiers urpx:ServiceBracket ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ProfileAlternative ;
    rdfs:comment "IRI reference linking pricing, schedule, or tier resources to their applicable ProfileAlternative." ;
    skos:note "Use on PriceSetAlternative, PriceDefinition, TOUSchedule, ServiceTiers, or ServiceBracket to scope applicability to a specific ProfileAlternative. ServiceBracket uses this property for profile-specific boundary variants." .

urpx:referencesProfileAlternatives a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "References Profile Alternatives"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:PriceSetAlternatives urpx:PriceDefinition ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ProfileAlternatives ;
    rdfs:comment "Links price set alternatives or price definition container to the profile alternatives definition." ;
    skos:note "Each PriceSetAlternatives must reference exactly one ProfileAlternatives. Each contained PriceSetAlternative must reference a ProfileAlternative from this ProfileAlternatives." .

urpx:referencesRatePlan a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "References Rate Plan"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Links prior rate plan to the actual rate plan" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PriorRatePlan ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RatePlan ;
    skos:note "References the rate plan customer was previously enrolled in." .

urpx:referencesServiceBracket a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "References Service Bracket"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "IRI reference to an exact service bracket for price application" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:PriceSetAlternative ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ServiceBracket ;
    skos:note "Optional direct reference to the exact ServiceBracket that a Price, PriceDefinition, or PriceSet uses. May be carried alongside serviceTierNumber or referencesServiceTier as a consistency check, but is not required." .

urpx:referencesServiceTier a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "References Service Tier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "IRI reference to a logical service tier for price application" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:PriceSetAlternative ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ServiceTier ;
    skos:note "IRI-based reference to the logical ServiceTier instance. Use when direct tier dereferencing is helpful. Actual lower and upper bounds are carried by attached ServiceBracket instances." .

urpx:referencesTouPeriod a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "References TOU Period"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "IRI reference to TOU period for price application" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:TOUPeriod ;
    skos:note "IRI-based reference to TOUPeriod instance defined in MetricInput. Enables direct dereferencing for period metadata including time brackets and multipliers." .

urpx:referencesValue a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "References Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "IRI reference to an object or enumeration value used by an object operand node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ObjectOperandNode ;
    rdfs:range owl:Thing ;
    skos:note "IRI-based value slot for object-property and enumeration comparisons in condition modeling." .

urpx:regulatoryApproval a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Regulatory Approval"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Reference to regulatory approval document" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:OrganizationEvent urpx:OrganizationTransition ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Regulatory approval document reference. E.g., FERC order number, PUC docket." .

urpx:regulatoryScope a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Regulatory Scope"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Scope of regulatory oversight (regulatory functions)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:RegulatoryAuthority ;
    rdfs:range urpx:RegulatoryScopeValue ;
    skos:note "Regulatory functions enumeration. Standardized regulatory authority categorization for energy systems." .

urpx:rightOperand a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Right Operand"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Right operand for ordered comparison or nested operation evaluation"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:ComparisonNode urpx:OperationNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:ObjectOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode urpx:OperationNode ) ] ;
    skos:note "Used on ComparisonNode and OperationNode only." .

urpx:rootNode a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Root Node"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Points from a ConditionExpression to its single root ConditionNode"@en ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ConditionExpression ;
    rdfs:range [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf (
                urpx:ConditionNode
                urpx:ComparisonNode
                urpx:BooleanOperationNode
            ) ] ;
    skos:note "Exactly one rootNode is present on each ConditionExpression." .

urpx:roundTripEfficiency a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Round Trip Efficiency"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Round trip efficiency as percentage" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DistributedEnergyResource ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Battery round trip efficiency (0-100%). Affects economic calculations for storage rates." .

urpx:seasonalPattern a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Seasonal Pattern"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Seasonal usage pattern classification" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:SeasonalPatternValue ;
    skos:note "Usage patterns enumeration for seasonal usage classification. with standardized seasonal pattern definitions." .

urpx:seasonName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Season Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Name for this season" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Season ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "E.g., 'Summer', 'Winter', 'Peak Season'. Human-readable identifier for season." .

urpx:serviceClassCleaned a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Service Class Cleaned"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Cleaned alphanumeric service class identifier" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServiceClass ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Normalized format for system processing." .

urpx:serviceClassName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Service Class Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Human-readable service class name" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServiceClass ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Descriptive name for the service class." .

urpx:serviceClassPattern a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Service Class Pattern"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Service class pattern for applicability and eligibility matching" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Supports regex patterns like 'SC 1 Rate II' or 'SC [1-3] Rate.*'." .

urpx:serviceClassRaw a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Service Class Raw"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Raw service class identifier as published in tariff" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServiceClass ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Original format from utility tariff book." .

urpx:serviceRole a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Service Role"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Service role for rate plan (distribution/retail/bundled)" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:EnergyServiceProvider urpx:PriorRatePlan ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:ServiceRoleValue ;
    skos:note "Service roles: distribution, retail, bundled. Indicates the utility's role in service delivery." .

urpx:serviceTierNumber a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Service Tier Number"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Integer reference to the logical service tier" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:PriceSetAlternative urpx:ServiceTier ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "Integer-based logical tier identifier. A price may use serviceTierNumber alone when the matching ServiceTiers container and ServiceBracket are derived through metric-input and contextual matching." .

urpx:settlementInterval a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Settlement Interval"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Period over which ledger balances are settled" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Ledger ;
    rdfs:range xsd:duration ;
    skos:note "Enables multi-period accumulation. Example: P12M for NBT 12-month true-up. ISO 8601 duration format." .

urpx:smartChargingEnabled a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Smart Charging Enabled"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Smart charging capability enabled" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DistributedEnergyResource ;
    rdfs:range xsd:boolean ;
    skos:note "Whether managed charging, vehicle-to-grid, or time-of-use charging is supported. Enables smart charging rates." .

urpx:solarCapacity a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Solar Capacity"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Solar generation capacity in kW" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DistributedEnergyResource ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Installed solar photovoltaic capacity. Used for net metering and solar-specific rates." .

urpx:specialNeedsStatus a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Special Needs Status"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Special needs classification" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:SpecialNeedsStatusValue ;
    skos:note "Special needs: medical equipment, disability accommodation, life support, vulnerable customer, none. Affects rate eligibility and service priority." .

urpx:startTime a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Start Time"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Start time for this bracket" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TimeBracket ;
    rdfs:range xsd:time ;
    skos:note "24-hour format (e.g., 09:00:00). Timezone context inherited from parent TOUSchedule's timeZone property for proper temporal alignment." .

urpx:startDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Start Date"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "The start date and time of the item (in ISO 8601 date format)" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet urpx:TOUPeriod urpx:BillingCycle urpx:Season ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:date ;
    skos:note "Represents when prices and pricing structures begin applying to customers." .

urpx:startDateTime a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Start Date"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "The start date and time of the item (in ISO 8601 date format)" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceSet urpx:TOUPeriod urpx:BillingCycle urpx:Season ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:dateTime ;
    skos:note "Represents when prices and pricing structures begin applying to customers." .

urpx:storageCapacity a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Storage Capacity"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Energy storage capacity in kWh" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DistributedEnergyResource ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Battery storage capacity. Used for storage-specific rates and grid services." .

urpx:stringValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "String Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "String literal value used in a condition operand node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "String literal value for condition modeling." .

urpx:summaryAmount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Summary Amount"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Calculated total value for this summary" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:PriceSummary ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Total amount calculated by summing all prices referenced via includesPrice. For aggregation summaries, this equals sum of included price amounts. For calculation-based summaries using basedOnPrice, this equals formula result. Currency inherited from parent PriceSet or document level." .

urpx:supersedes a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Supersedes"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "References the previous version this one replaces" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ) ] ;
    rdfs:range [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion ) ] ;
    skos:note "Creates version chain for audit trail. Superseded version should end when this begins. Rate plan versions can supersede other rate plan versions, and modifier versions can supersede other modifier versions." .

urpx:targetURPXVersion a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Target URPX Version"@en ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:URPXDocument ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    rdfs:comment "The URPX ontology version this document was authored against." ;
    skos:note "Required on all URPXDocument instances. Enables version-aware parsing and validation. Value should be the ontology version IRI, e.g. 'https://github.com/urpx-org/urpx/raw/v0.2.0/ontology/urpx-ontology.ttl'." .

urpx:tariffStatementType a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Tariff Statement Type"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Type of regulatory statement filing (PSC statement types)" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:TariffStatementDocument urpx:TariffStatementReference ) ] ;
    rdfs:range urpx:TariffStatementTypeValue ;
    skos:note "PSC statement types enumeration for regulatory statement categorization. with standardized statement type definitions." .

urpx:taxExemptStatus a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Tax Exempt Status"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Tax exemption status" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:TaxExemptStatusValue ;
    skos:note "Tax exemption classifications: exempt, non-exempt, partial exempt, pending verification. Used for tax-based rate eligibility." .

urpx:tierSourceName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Tier Source Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Utility's original name for this tier" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TOUTier ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Preserves utility's terminology for reference and mapping." .

urpx:timeValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Time Value"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Time literal value used in a condition operand node"@en ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:DatatypeOperandNode urpx:CustomOperandNode ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:time ;
    skos:note "Time literal value for condition modeling." .

urpx:timezoneIdentifier a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Timezone Identifier"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "IANA timezone identifier for this location dataset" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:LocationDataSet urpx:URPXDocument urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanModifier ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Standard IANA timezone identifier (e.g., 'America/New_York'). Used for temporal calculations and DST handling." .

urpx:touPeriodNumber a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "TOU Period Number"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Integer reference to TOU period ID for price application" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:Price urpx:PriceDefinition urpx:PriceSet urpx:TOUPeriod ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "Integer-based reference to TOUPeriod via its unique touPeriodNumber. Must be unique across entire schedule for unambiguous period identification." .

urpx:touTierNumber a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "TOU Tier Number"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Tier number in descending price order (1=highest price)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TOUTier ;
    rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
    skos:note "1 = highest price tier (peak), higher numbers = lower prices." .

urpx:touTierStandardName a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "TOU Tier Standard Name"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Standard TOU tier type name for time-of-use pricing tiers" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:TOUTier ;
    rdfs:range urpx:TOUTierStandardNameValue ;
    skos:note "Industry standard TOU tier terminology enumeration. with standardized tier naming for consistent time-of-use operations across utilities." .

urpx:unitOfMeasure a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Unit of Measure"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Industry-standard unit of measure specification" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:MetricSpecification ;
    rdfs:range urpx:UnitOfMeasureValue ;
    skos:note "Unit of measure enumeration covering energy, demand, volume, weight, area, time, and other measurement units. Property used in MetricSpecification for price measurement specifications, with comprehensive utility industry coverage." .

urpx:unitPrice a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Unit Price"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Price per unit of consumption" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Price ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Per-unit pricing for usage-based prices. Use with unit property to specify pricing basis." .

urpx:updateFrequency a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Update Frequency"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "How frequently dynamic prices are updated (ISO 8601 intervals)" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DynamicPricing ;
    rdfs:range urpx:UpdateFrequencyValue ;
    skos:note "ISO 8601 interval enumeration for dynamic pricing update frequency. with standardized temporal interval definitions." .

urpx:upperBound a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Upper Bound"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Upper threshold value for bracket applicability" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServiceBracket ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Maximum value for this service bracket. Used with upperBoundOperator to determine boundary comparison logic." .

urpx:upperBoundOperator a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Upper Bound Operator"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Comparison operator for upper bound evaluation" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServiceBracket ;
    rdfs:range urpx:OperatorValue ;
    skos:note "Use lessThanOrEqualOperator for inclusive upper bounds or lessThanOperator for exclusive upper bounds." .

urpx:url a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "URL"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "URL of the item" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:TariffPublication urpx:URPXDocument urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:DataSourceReference urpx:ProgramEnrollment urpx:RateCase ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:note "Direct link to PDF, HTML, or other document format." .

urpx:usageThreshold a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Usage Threshold"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Annual usage threshold in kWh" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:CustomerProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Used for usage-based rate eligibility." .

urpx:usageVariability a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Usage Variability"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Usage variability coefficient" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Statistical measure of usage pattern consistency for service point profile." .

urpx:utilityId a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Utility ID"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Utility identifier as defined by the implementing jurisdiction" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:OrganizationIdentifier ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    rdfs:subPropertyOf urpx:identifierValue ;
    skos:note "Generic utility identifier property. Each URPX implementation specifies the identifier system used (e.g., US EIA ID, UK MPAN, EU EIC code). For standard identifier types, use identifierScheme to specify the system." ;
    skos:example "US: EIA-12345, UK: S12345678901, EU: 12X-UTILITY-A" .

urpx:version a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Version"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "The version of the CreativeWork embodied by a specified resource" ;
    rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( urpx:RatePlanVersion urpx:RatePlan urpx:RatePlanModifier urpx:RatePlanModifierVersion urpx:TariffPublication urpx:URPXDocument ) ] ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:note "Semantic versioning format recommended for rate plan changes." .

urpx:voltageLevel a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Voltage Level"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Service voltage level classification for service point profiles" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:ServicePointProfile ;
    rdfs:range urpx:VoltageLevelValue ;
    skos:note "Voltage level enumeration used for service point voltage specification (ServicePointProfile) and price applicability rules (through ConditionExpression on ApplicabilityRule or ApplicabilityGroup). Standardized voltage class definitions enable consistent voltage-based rate application across utilities." .

urpx:windCapacity a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Wind Capacity"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Wind generation capacity in kW" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:DistributedEnergyResource ;
    rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
    skos:note "Small wind turbine capacity. Used for wind-specific rates and interconnection requirements." .


urpx:yearlyRecurrence a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "Yearly Recurrence"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Whether this season recurs yearly" ;
    rdfs:domain urpx:Season ;
    rdfs:range xsd:boolean ;
    skos:note "True for annual patterns, false for one-time seasons. Enables seasonal rate structures that repeat annually." .

# --- Accumulation Method Property (AccumulationValue) ---

    skos:prefLabel "Delta" .
